name: Acid Splash
description: Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Befriend
components: S, M (1 copper piece, which the spell consumes)
description: You ensorcel one creature within range, compelling it to like you. For the duration, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks against the target. Afterward, the target becomes aware of the magical influence and turns hostile toward you.

name: Benediction
description: You imbue one creature within range with magical encouragement. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll 1d4 and add it to one ability check of its choice, before or after rolling. Creatures with Intelligence 4 or higher that perceive your spellcasting become aware of the magic.

name: Black Ice
description:
Until the spell ends, the magic ice fills a 5-foot square. Any creature on the ice when you cast must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 cold damage and fall prone (Medium or smaller). A creature moving onto or ending its turn on the ice must repeat the save.

This spell's damage increases by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Blade Burst
description: All other creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 slashing or piercing damage (your choice). This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Until then, the hand clings to the target. If you hit an undead target, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Dancing Lights
components: V, S, M (A bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm.)
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range that hover in the air for the duration, or combine them into one glowing humanoid form. Each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. As a bonus action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet; each light must remain within 20 feet of another, and lights wink out if they exceed the spell's range.

name: Draining Bolt
description:
You sap the vitality of one creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Druidcraft
description: Whispering to nature's spirits, you create one effect within range: predict the weather for the next 24 hours (lasts 1 round); instantly bloom a flower or open a seed pod; create a harmless sensory effect fitting in a 5-foot cube; or instantly light or snuff a candle, torch, or small campfire.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

name: Ghost Lights
components: V, S, M (a bit of tungsten or hickory, or a firefly)
description: You create up to four lights within range that hover for the duration. Each sheds dim light in a 15-foot radius in a color of your choice. As a bonus action, you can extinguish or move any lights up to 60 feet; each must stay within 30 feet of another. Lights wink out if they exceed the spell's range. Casting this spell again instantly extinguishes any prior lights.

name: Ghost Touch
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can’t regain hit points until the start of your next turn. If you hit an undead target, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Grave Call
description: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 1d8 necrotic damage. If it is below half its maximum hit points, the damage increases to 1d12. This spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level (2d8 or 2d12), 11th level (3d8 or 3d12), and 17th level (4d8 or 4d12).

name: Guidance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

name: Light
components: V, M (A firefly or phosphorescent moss.)
description: You touch one object up to 10 feet in any dimension. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for 20 more feet, in a color of your choice. Covering it blocks the light. The spell ends if cast again or dismissed as an action. If the object is held by a hostile creature, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.

name: Lightning Leash
description:
Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet. On a hit, it takes 1d6 lightning damage and is ensnared. If it moves outside the spell's range before your next turn, you can use your reaction to yank the leash—it makes a Strength saving throw or takes 1d6 lightning damage and has its speed halved until your next turn, then the leash dissipates.

Both damage rolls increase by 1d6 at 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral hand appears within range and lasts for the duration. As an action, you can control it to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors or containers, stow or retrieve items from open containers, or pour vials. The hand moves up to 30 feet per use, can't attack or activate magic items, and can't carry more than 10 pounds. It vanishes if more than 30 feet from you.

name: Manipulate Earth
description: Choose one effect within range: excavate a 5-foot cube of loose dirt or soil and move it up to 5 feet; make minor alterations to dirt or stone (color, simple shapes); or create up to three 5-foot squares of difficult terrain from earth or stone for 1 hour (creating a fourth removes the first).

name: Manipulate Fire
description: Choose one effect within range: grant one creature resistance to fire damage until your next turn; spark or spread fire in a 5-foot cube (requires fuel); douse fire in a 5-foot cube; or adjust a flame's brightness, color, or shape in a 5-foot cube for 10 minutes.

name: Manipulate Water
description: Choose one effect within range: move a 5-foot cube of water in a chosen direction (reverts next turn unless concentrated); mold water into small shapes or animations for 1 minute; change color or opacity of a 5-foot cube of water for 1 hour; or freeze or thaw up to a 5-foot cube of water or ice.

name: Manipulate Wind
description: Choose one effect within range: impose disadvantage on the next ranged weapon attack against a creature you choose; force a Large or smaller creature to make a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet or knocked prone; increase a creature's next jump by 5 feet; or create a minor wind effect (push a light object 10 feet, rustle plants, slam a door, etc.).

name: Mending
description: As long as the break or tear is no longer than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage. This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can't restore magic to such an object.

name: Message
components: V, S, M (A short piece of copper wire.)
description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target hears the message and can whisper a reply that only you hear. The spell can pass through solid objects if you know the target is beyond them, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood. It doesn't need to follow a straight line.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range lasting 1 minute. A sound can range from a whisper to a scream, continuous or at intervals. An image must fit in a 5-foot cube and cannot produce sound, light, or smell. Physical interaction reveals the illusion. A creature can use its action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it.

name: Poison Fang
description:
You conjure a spectral snake that bites down on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

name: Poison Spray
description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

name: Prestidigitation
description: Choose one magical effect within range: create a harmless sensory effect; light or snuff a small flame; instantly clean or soil an object (1 cubic foot); chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour; create a color, mark, or symbol on a surface for 1 hour; or create a small trinket or illusory image in your hand (until end of next turn). You can have up to three non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

name: Produce Flame
description:
A flickering flame appears in your hand, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for 10 more feet, harming neither you nor your gear. You can hurl it at a creature within 30 feet as an action (ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire damage), ending the spell.

Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Ray of Frost
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Resistance
description: Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature within range. The target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Shillelagh
components: V, S, M (Mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff.)
description: For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. The weapon also becomes magical, if it isn't already. The spell ends if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
higherLevel: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Spare the Dying
description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Stinging Insects
description:
A cloud of biting insects swarms one creature within range. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d4 piercing and 1d4 poison damage and moves 5 feet in a direction you choose (not into obvious danger).

Damage increases by 1d4+1d4 at 5th level (2d4+2d4), 11th level (3d4+3d4), and 17th level (4d4+4d4).

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest a minor wonder within range. Choose one effect: your voice booms up to three times as loud for 1 minute; flames flicker, dim, or change color for 1 minute; harmless tremors shake the ground for 1 minute; create an instantaneous sound from any point within range; an unlocked door or window flies open or slams shut; or your eyes change appearance for 1 minute. You can have up to three 1-minute effects active at a time.

name: Thought Wisp
description: You create a glowing floating orb containing a thought, memory, or message (yellow=idea, silver=memory, blue=message). You can limit who may receive its contents. Any designated creature can use its action to receive the wisp's contents, ending the spell. A creature with the ability to cast this spell or concentrating on a mind-reading spell can also receive it. Any creature can touch the wisp and use its action to disperse it, ending the spell.

name: Thunder Burst
description:
You create a concussive pulse, producing a boom audible out to 300 feet. All other creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.

The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: True Strike
description: Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn't ended.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
higherLevel: This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Alarm
components: V, S, M (A tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire.)
description: You ward a door, window, or area up to a 20-foot cube within range. For the duration, an alarm triggers when a Tiny or larger creature enters or touches the warded area. You can designate creatures that won't trigger it. Choose mental (a ping within 1 mile, waking you if asleep) or audible (a hand bell sound for 10 seconds within 60 feet).

name: Animal Friendship
components: V, S, M (A morsel of food.)
description: Choose a beast within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast for each slot level above 1st.

name: Arctic Breath
description:
A line of freezing arctic wind 30 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction of your choice. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, a creature takes 2d8 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t slowed.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Bane
components: V, S, M (A drop of blood.)
description: Up to three creatures of your choice within range must make charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Befriend Beast
components: V, S, M (a biscuit baked out of meat and grain)
description: Choose a beast within range that can see and hear you. It makes a Wisdom saving throw or becomes charmed by you for the duration. Beasts with Intelligence 4 or higher automatically succeed. While charmed, it willingly performs simple tasks (scouting, finding objects, delivering items). It covers 1 mile per hour walking (2 miles flying). Harming the beast ends the spell.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level slot, duration increases to 24 hours. Using a 3rd-level slot or higher, you can either add +24 hours per slot above 2nd, or affect one additional beast per slot above 2nd.

name: Bless
components: V, S, M (A sprinkling of holy water.)
description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Burning Hands
description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Charm Person
description: It must make a wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Color Spray
components: V, S, M (A pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue.)
description: Roll 6d10 to get a hit point total. Creatures in a 15-foot cone are blinded until the spell ends, affected in ascending hit point order until they equal or exceed the remaining total. Unconscious creatures and those that can't see are ignored.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level slot or higher, roll an additional 2d10 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command to a creature within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw or follows the command on its next turn. Undead, creatures that don't understand you, and directly harmful commands are unaffected. Common commands: Approach (move to within 5 feet of you), Drop (drop held items), Flee (move away fastest), Grovel (fall prone), Halt (don't move or act; flying creatures stay aloft).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level slot or higher, affect one additional creature per slot level above 1st. Targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

name: Comprehend Languages
components: V, S, M (A pinch of soot and salt.)
description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode secret messages in a text or a glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that isn't part of a written language.

name: Cone of Flame
description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. The flames ignite any flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the range of the cone increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Create or Destroy Water
components: V, S, M (A drop of water if creating water, or a few grains of sand if destroying it.)
description:
Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot cube within range

 Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot cube within range.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the cube increases by 5 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Dazzle
components: V, S, M (a small glass prism)
description: Each creature in a 20-foot cone perceives your space as heavily obscured and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is blinded and its speed is halved. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the cone’s size increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Deflect
description: A transparent sphere of arcane force appears, averting incoming attacks. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, to a maximum of 21 AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the bonus to AC (and the maximum AC) increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 1st (for example, when cast with a 5th-level spell slot, you have a +7 bonus to AC, to a maximum of 23 AC).

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where it is. You also detect consecrated or desecrated places and objects within 30 feet. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Magic
description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet. As an action, you can see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object and learn its school of magic. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Otherworldly Influence
description: The spell reveals the existence of any aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as their locations. You also have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Insight) checks against such creatures for the duration. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case. The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Disguise Self
description: You alter the appearance of yourself, your clothing, armor, weapons, and belongings for the duration. You can appear up to 1 foot shorter or taller or of different build, but cannot change your basic limb arrangement. The illusion fails under physical inspection. A creature can use its action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through the disguise.

name: Divine Favor
description: Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

name: Earth Rumble
description: Each other creature within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone. If the terrain is dirt or stone, it becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than you for the next hour.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st, and the radius increases by 5 feet for every two slot levels above 1st.

name: Eldritch Armor
components: V, S, M (a vial of snowmelt)
description: You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these temporary hit points, the creature takes 2d4 acid damage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the acid damage increase by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st, up to a maximum of 9d4 + 4 temporary hit points and 10d4 damage at 5th level.

name: Eldritch Rift
description: Each other creature within 10 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 3d4 necrotic damage and is gripped by the tentacles, preventing it from making reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and instead has disadvantage on opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st, and you can increase the spell’s radius by up to 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Elemental Reflection
description: When you are hit by acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, choose one option until the end of your next turn: gain resistance to that damage type; or deal an extra 1d8 damage of that type on your next weapon attack, plus a bonus effect (acid: 1d4 at end of target's next turn; cold: -10 ft speed; fire: ignite flammables; lightning: target loses reactions; thunder: target deafened).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level slot or higher, the additional damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range, making the area difficult terrain. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast must make a Strength saving throw or become restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to free itself. The plants wilt when the spell ends.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Every object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw or is also outlined in light. Outlined creatures and objects shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, cannot benefit from invisibility, and all attack rolls against them have advantage.

name: False Life
components: V, S, M (A small amount of alcohol or distilled spirits.)
description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you gain 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

name: Fated Strike
description: The next attack the creature makes before the end of your next turn hits regardless of any modifiers or the target’s AC.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the number of attacks that creature makes which automatically hit increases by one for every two slot levels above 1st.

name: Fearsome Visage
description: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for the duration. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that is more than 90 feet away from you has advantage on its saving throw.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Feather Fall
components: V, M (A small feather or a piece of down.)
description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.

name: Find Familiar
components: V, S, M (10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs that must be consumed by fire in a brass brazier)
description: You gain a familiar in one of these animal forms: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, quipper, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel. The familiar is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice). It obeys your commands, can't attack, and communicates telepathically within 100 feet. As an action, you can see and hear through it (becoming deaf and blind yourself). You can dismiss it to a pocket dimension and resummon it within 30 feet. While within 100 feet, it can deliver your touch spells using its reaction.

name: Find in Nature
components: V, S, M (a tuft of hound's fur)
description: This spell helps you locate a specific kind of beast or plant, which you can either name or describe. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 1 mile, if any are present.
higherLevel: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level, the range of the spell increases to 5 miles. If you use a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 5 additional miles for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Floating Disk
components: V, S, M (A drop of mercury.)
description: A 3-foot diameter, 1-inch thick horizontal plane of force hovers 3 feet off the ground in an unoccupied space within range. It holds up to 500 pounds; exceeding this ends the spell. The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet; otherwise it follows you. It can traverse uneven terrain and stairs but not elevation changes of 10 feet or more. The spell ends if you move more than 100 feet away.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Frost Shuriken
components: S, M (a palmful of water and a piece of iron)
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 piercing damage and 2d8 cold damage. The shuriken then explodes (whether you hit or miss). Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 cold damage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the cold damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Goodberry
components: V, S, M (A sprig of mistletoe.)
description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. The berries lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

name: Grease
components: V, S, M (A bit of pork rind or butter.)
description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Heroism
description: Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell.

name: Hideous Laughter
components: V, S, M (Tiny tarts and a feather that is waved in the air.)
description: One creature within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and become incapacitated with laughter for the duration. Creatures with Intelligence 4 or less are immune. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target may repeat the saving throw (with advantage if triggered by damage), ending the spell on a success.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You mark one creature you can see within range. You deal an extra 1d6 damage to it on weapon attacks, and have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it. When the target drops to 0 hit points, you can use a bonus action to mark a new creature.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 3rd- or 4th-level slot, concentration lasts up to 8 hours. Using a 5th-level slot or higher, up to 24 hours.

name: Identify
components: V, S, M (A pearl worth at least 100gp and an owl feather.)
description: Touching a magic item throughout the casting, you learn its properties, whether it requires attunement, its charges, any spells affecting it, and what spell created it. Touching a creature instead reveals what spells are currently affecting it.

name: Illusory Script
components: S, M (A lead-based ink worth at least 10gp, which this spell consumes.)
description: You write on a surface and imbue it with illusion. You and designated creatures see the true writing. All others see unintelligible magical script, or an entirely different message in a different hand and language of your choice (a language you know). Truesight reveals the true message. Dispelling ends both the script and the illusion.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Jump
components: V, S, M (A grasshopper's hind leg.)
description: The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

name: Lightning Tendril
description: For the duration of the spell, as an action, you can direct them toward a creature within range, dealing 1d12 lightning damage to that creature.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd- or 3rd-level spell slot, the damage increases to 2d12 and the range increases to 30 feet. When you cast it using a 4th- or 5th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d12 and the range increases to 60 feet.

name: Longstrider
components: V, S, M (A pinch of dirt.)
description: The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each spell slot above 1st.

name: Mage Armor
components: V, S, M (A piece of cured leather.)
description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

name: Magic Fruit
components: V, S, M (up to 10 pieces of freshly-picked fruit)
description: The fruit gains minor healing properties for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one fruit and restore 1 hit point. If a creature eats 10 infused fruits, the magic combines to provide enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

name: Magic Missile
description: Each dart hits a creature of your choice within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

name: Magic Net
components: S, M (a length of wire, string, cord, or rope worth at least 5 sp, which the spell consumes)
description: You create an invisible cylindrical trap (5-foot radius, 10-foot high) at a ground point within range. It can be detected with an Intelligence check against your spell save DC; detected creatures are immune. When a creature enters the cylinder, it makes a Dexterity saving throw or becomes restrained and is lifted 10 feet upside down. Huge or larger creatures automatically succeed. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your spell save DC to escape.

name: Minor Drain
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you gain half the damage dealt as temporary hit points. These temporary hit points fade after 1 minute.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Misfortune
description: The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the lower roll.

name: Prismatic Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, roll a d8 for effect: 1=2d4 acid now+3d4 acid at end of target's next turn; 2=2d8 cold+speed halved; 3=3d6 fire; 4=3d4 force+knocked prone (Large or smaller); 5=1d12 lightning+no reactions; 6=1d12 poison+poisoned; 7=2d8 psychic+charmed by you; 8=2d8 thunder+deafened. Effects last until end of target's next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level slot or higher, the initial damage roll increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
components: V, S, M (Holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes.)
description: One willing creature you touch gains protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. Those creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them. If already charmed, frightened, or possessed by such a creature, the target gains advantage on new saving throws against those effects.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot radius sphere centered on a chosen point within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

name: Sacred Strikes
description: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage for the duration.

name: Sanctuary
components: V, S, M (A small silver mirror.)
description: Ward a creature within range against attack. Any creature targeting it with an attack or harmful spell must first succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. Doesn't protect against area effects. The ward ends if the protected creature attacks or casts a spell that affects an enemy.

name: Secret Missive
components: S, M (A lead-based ink worth at least 10gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Write a secret message on parchment with a password trigger. The writing is invisible except to those who know the password—on a successful Intelligence (History) check vs. your spell save DC or by speaking the password, the message becomes readable for 10 minutes. Without a passphrase, writing persists 10 days (10gp ink) or permanently (100gp ink). Truesight reveals the hidden text.

name: Shield
description: Reaction, cast when hit or targeted by magic missile. Until the start of your next turn: +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile damage.

name: Shield of Faith
components: V, S, M (A small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it.)
description: A creature within 60 feet gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Silent Image
components: V, S, M (A bit of fleece.)
description: Create a purely visual illusion of an object, creature, or force up to 15 feet in any dimension at a point within 60 feet. Use your action to move it up to 60 feet or change its appearance. Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion. A creature can use its action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs. your spell save DC to disbelieve.

name: Sleep
components: V, S, M (A pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket.)
description: Roll 5d8. Creatures within a 20-foot radius sphere in ascending HP order fall unconscious, as long as sufficient hit points remain. They remain unconscious until the spell ends, they take damage, or someone wakes them. Undead and creatures immune to charm are unaffected.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. Beasts can share knowledge of nearby locations, monsters, and anything from the past day. You may be able to persuade them to perform small favors.

name: Speak with Nature
description: Comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. 2nd-level slot: also communicate with plants. 3rd-level slot: also temporarily animate plants.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you imbue plants with limited sentience, allowing you to communicate with them like beasts. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you imbue plants with limited animation, allowing them to freely move branches, tendrils, and stalks.

name: Thunderwave
description: Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. Fail: 2d8 thunder damage and pushed 10 feet away. Success: half damage, not pushed. Unsecured objects are also pushed 10 feet. The thunderclap is audible 300 feet away.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Unseen Servant
components: V, S, M (A piece of string and a bit of wood.)
description: Create an invisible, mindless, shapeless force (AC 10, 1 hp, Strength 2). Use a bonus action to command it: move up to 15 feet and interact with one object. Performs simple tasks (fetch, clean, fold, etc.). Can't attack or take reactions. Ends if more than 60 feet from you.

name: Warding Sigil
description: Create a ward with 4 hp, resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Damage you take is redirected to the ward instead. Spell ends when the ward reaches 0 hp.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the ward gains an additional 2d4 hit points for each slot level above 1st.

name: Acid Arrow
components: V, S, M (Powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach.)
description: Make a ranged spell attack. Hit: 4d4 acid damage immediately plus 2d4 acid at the end of the target's next turn. Miss: half the initial damage only.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the initial damage and the subsequent damage each increase by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Adaptation
description: Touch a willing creature. Choose one adaptation: (a) gills and webbing—swim speed equals walking speed; (b) glide membrane—reduce falling up to 100 ft; (c) prehensile tail—5-ft reach, carry 5×Strength lbs; (d) change appearance (not size or shape); (e) natural weapon dealing 1d6 damage, +1 magic bonus. Use an action to switch options.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the natural weapon bonus increases to +2 (4th), then +3 (6th). You can also select one additional adaptation per 2 slot levels above 2nd.

name: Aid
components: V, S, M (A tiny strip of white cloth.)
description: Up to three creatures within 30 feet gain +5 to their hit point maximum and current hit points for 8 hours.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, each target's hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Alter Self
description: Choose one option, switchable as an action: (a) Aquatic Adaptation: gills, swim speed equals walking speed; (b) Change Appearance: transform height, weight, face, voice, or hair within your size category; (c) Natural Weapons: 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing unarmed strikes that count as magical with a +1 bonus.

name: Animal Ally
components: V, S, M (a biscuit baked out of meat and grain)
description: Use an action to perceive through a beast's senses until the start of your next turn. While within 120 feet, you share a telepathic link; the beast adds your proficiency bonus to ability checks, deals +1d6 damage on hits, and has advantage on attack rolls against creatures you have attacked.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration extends to 8 hours (4th) or 24 hours (6th).

name: Animal Messenger
components: V, S, M (A morsel of food.)
description: Compel a Tiny beast within range to deliver a message. Speak up to 25 words; name a recipient by description and location. The beast travels 50 miles/day flying or 25 miles/day on foot. On arrival, it delivers the message in your voice only to a creature matching your description.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Arcane Lock
components: V, S, M (Gold dust worth at least 25gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a closed door, window, gate, or container to lock it permanently with magic. Designated creatures can open it normally. Speaking the password suppresses the lock for 1 minute. The knock spell suppresses it for 10 minutes. The DC to break or pick the lock increases by 10.

name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
components: V, S, M (A small square of silk.)
description: Place one or both illusions on a creature or object, lasting 24 hours (permanent after 30 consecutive days): (a) False Aura: alter or suppress how detect magic perceives it; (b) Mask: change what divination magic reveals about its creature type or alignment.

name: Augury
components: V, S, M (Specially marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens worth at least 25gp.)
description: Receive an omen (Weal, Woe, Weal and Woe, or Nothing) about an action you describe within the next 30 minutes. The omen doesn't account for changed circumstances. Each casting beyond the first per long rest has a cumulative 25% chance of returning a random reading.

name: Aura of Concealment
components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash and a cotton bud)
description: You and chosen allies within a 30-foot radius gain +5 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks or traces.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the bonus increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Aura of Truth
description: A 15-foot radius aura moves with you. The first time a creature ends its turn in the area, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be unable to intentionally lie while in the aura. As an action, ask up to 2 yes-or-no questions requiring truthful answers, then the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius increases by 5 feet and you can ask one additional question for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Barkskin
components: V, S, M (A handful of oak bark.)
description: Touch a willing creature. The target's AC can't be less than 16 for the duration.

name: Beast Perception
components: S, M (a tuft of fur, feathers, or dried skin of the beast the spell mimics))
description: Choose one sense (switchable as an action): Darkvision 30 ft; Echolocation 10 ft (requires constant high-pitched sound); Keen Hearing (advantage on Perception checks using hearing); Keen Sight; Keen Smell; Tremorsense 30 ft; Websense (know locations of all creatures touching the same web).

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: One creature within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become blinded or deafened for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blur
description: Attack rolls against you have disadvantage for the duration. Immune: creatures using blindsight, truesight, or similar senses.

name: Branding Smite
description: The next time you hit with a weapon attack, deal +2d6 radiant damage. The target becomes visible if invisible, sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius, and can't become invisible again until the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra radiant damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Burst of Flame
description: Choose a point within 60 feet (enhanced if targeting an existing flame). Choose one effect: (a) Light: 10-ft radius (20 ft on flame), CON save or blinded until end of next turn; (b) Heat: 10-ft radius, 3d6 fire damage (4d6 on flame), CON save for half; (c) Smoke: heavily obscured 15-ft cloud (30 ft on flame), lasts 1 minute or until strong wind.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Up to 10 creatures in a 20-foot radius sphere make a Charisma saving throw (they may choose to fail). For each affected creature, choose: (a) suppress the charmed or frightened condition until the spell ends; or (b) make it indifferent toward specified hostile creatures until it is attacked or harmed, or the spell ends.

name: Captivate
description: One creature within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you. While charmed: disadvantage on initiative rolls and Perception checks to notice others, speed reduced by 10 ft, no reactions until after its first turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration increases by 1 minute and the radius increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Caustic Quarrel
components: V, S, M (a bit of fool's gold, sulfur, and water)
description: Make a ranged spell attack. Hit: 6d4 acid damage and the target is coated in acid. The coating can be wiped off as an action; if not removed, the target takes an additional 4d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, both damage dice increase by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Cold Snap
description: Creatures in a 5-foot radius sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. Fail: 3d8 cold damage and speed reduced by 10 ft until the start of your next turn. Success: half damage, not slowed. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Conjure Herald
components: V, S, M (a small silver horn worth at least 10gp, which is consumed)
description: Create a floating magical spirit carrying a message of 25 words or fewer. Choose form: (a) Ward: anchored to a location or object, invisible until a chosen trigger condition occurs within 30 feet, then speaks the message (lasts until dispelled); (b) Announcement: drifts through a 5-mile radius at 30 ft/round up to 100 ft high, repeating the message every round for 1 hour.

name: Continual Flame
components: V, S, M (Ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Create a torch-equivalent flame on a touched object. The flame produces no heat and consumes no oxygen. It can be covered but not smothered.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: When a creature starts its turn or enters the 10-foot radius sphere, it must make a Constitution saving throw or be cursed until the end of that turn: disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws, Strength-based weapon damage halved, and speed reduced by 10 ft.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Darkness
components: V, M (Bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal.)
description: Magical darkness spreads in a 15-foot radius from a chosen point for 10 minutes. Blocks darkvision and extinguishes nonmagical light. Can be attached to an object to move with it. Can be blocked by opaque cover. Dispels light spells of 2nd level or lower that overlap with it.

name: Darkvision
components: V, S, M (Either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate.)
description: The touched creature gains darkvision to a range of 60 feet for 8 hours.

name: Detect Hazards
description: Sense any trap within 120 feet in line of sight (general presence and direction). Within 15 feet: pinpoint exact location and gain advantage on checks to examine or disarm it. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: Read the surface thoughts of a visible creature within 30 feet (Intelligence 3+, speaks a language). Use an action to probe deeper: on a failed Wisdom saving throw, learn its reasoning, emotional state, and foremost concern; on a success, the spell ends. The target is aware you are probing. Alternatively, detect the presence of thinking creatures within 30 feet (blocked by lead).

name: Dust Cyclone
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
description: Summon a 5-foot radius, 30-foot tall cylinder of swirling debris. Creatures starting their turn in or entering the area make a Strength saving throw. Fail: 1d12 bludgeoning damage and pushed 5 feet. Success: half damage, not pushed. Bonus action: move the cyclone up to 30 feet (first creature it passes through must save). Absorbs loose material, heavily obscuring the area.

name: Earth Leash
components: V, S, M (a tiny orange flag)
description: One creature within range must make a Strength saving throw. Fail: immediately knocked prone, loses any flying speed for the duration, and takes up to 4d6 bludgeoning damage from falling.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature and the maximum fall damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Enhance Ability
components: V, S, M (Fur or a feather from a beast.)
description: Touch a willing creature. Choose one enhancement for 1 hour: Bear's Endurance (advantage on Constitution checks, +2d6 temp hp); Bull's Strength (advantage on Strength checks, double carry capacity); Cat's Grace (advantage on Dexterity checks, no damage from falls ≤20 ft); Eagle's Splendor (advantage on Charisma checks); Fox's Cunning (advantage on Intelligence checks); Owl's Wisdom (advantage on Wisdom checks).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Enkindle
description: A Medium or smaller non-worn object within 60 feet heats to white-hot or ignites. The holder must make a Constitution saving throw each turn. Fail: 2d4 fire damage and disadvantage on attacks/checks with the item. Success: half damage, no other effect. Full 1 minute of concentration destroys the nonmagical item.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
components: V, S, M (A pinch iron powder.)
description: One creature or object within 30 feet grows or shrinks. Unwilling targets make a Constitution saving throw to resist. Enlarge: double size, ×8 weight, +1 size category, advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, +1d4 weapon damage. Reduce: half size, 1/8 weight, −1 size category, disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws, −1d4 weapon damage (minimum 1).

name: Enthrall
description: One creature within range that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Perception checks to notice anyone except you until the spell ends or it can no longer hear you. Immune: creatures that can't be charmed or that are in combat with you. Ends if you are incapacitated.

name: Fiery Blade
components: V, S, M (one flake of dried chili pepper)
description: Conjure a fiery scimitar in one free hand: simple melee weapon, you are proficient; deals 2d6 fire damage; finesse, light, thrown (20/60); sheds bright light 20 ft, dim light 20 ft. A hit on a flammable target ignites it for 1d6 fire/turn until extinguished. Dropping or throwing the blade dissipates it at end of turn; resummon as a bonus action.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, both the blade and burn damage increase by 1d6 for every 2 slot levels above 2nd.

name: Find Steed
description: Summon a spirit in the form of an intelligent steed (warhorse, pony, camel, elk, mastiff, etc.; type is celestial, fey, or fiend). It gains Intelligence 6, understands one language, and spells targeting only you can also target it. If it drops to 0 hp or is dismissed, it disappears; recasting returns the same steed at full hp. Telepathic link within 1 mile. Release it permanently as an action.

name: Find Traps
description: Sense the presence and general nature of any trap in line of sight within 120 feet. Does not reveal exact location.

name: Flame Blade
description: Evoke a fiery scimitar in one free hand (bonus action to evoke or re-evoke). Make a melee spell attack; hit: 3d6 fire damage. Sheds bright light 10 ft, dim light 10 ft.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Flaming Sphere
components: V, S, M (A bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron.)
description: Conjure a 5-foot diameter ball of fire in an unoccupied space within 60 feet. Creatures within 5 feet when it appears or at end of their turn make a Dexterity saving throw: 2d6 fire damage (half on success). Bonus action: move the sphere up to 30 feet; can ram through a space (Dexterity save). Ignites flammable objects. Sheds bright light 20 ft, dim 20 ft.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Force Weapon
description: Touch a weapon; it becomes magical with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls and deals +1d4 force damage. As a bonus action, toggle a glow (5–30 ft bright, equal dim, choose color).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2 and the extra damage increases to 1d6. At 6th level, the bonus increases to +3 and the extra damage increases to 1d8.

name: Fortune
description: Reaction: the triggering creature rerolls its d20 and must use the higher result.

name: Gentle Repose
components: V, S, M (A pinch of salt and one copper piece placed on each of the corpse's eyes, which must remain there for the duration.)
description: Touch a corpse. It is preserved from decay, cannot become undead, and days spent under this spell don't count against the time limit for raise dead and similar spells.

name: Gust of Wind
description: A strong wind blasts in a 60-foot line, 10 feet wide from you. Creatures starting their turn in the line make a Strength saving throw or are pushed 15 feet. Moving toward you costs 2 ft of movement per 1 ft. Disperses gases and vapors, extinguishes unprotected flames (50% chance for lanterns). Bonus action: change direction.

name: Hallucination
components: V, S, M (a small glass bottle)
description: One target creature perceives a vivid illusion you describe (up to a 10-foot cube) that only they can sense, including sound and smell. The target can examine it as an action: Intelligence (Investigation) vs. your spell save DC (advantage if able to touch). Bonus action: adjust the illusion within range.

name: Heat Metal
components: V, S, M (A piece of iron and a flame.)
description: Choose a manufactured metal object within 60 feet. The holder or wearer takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell and each time you use a bonus action on subsequent turns. On taking damage: Constitution saving throw or drop the item; if not dropped, disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Hold Person
components: V, S, M (A small, straight piece of iron.)
description: One humanoid within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. Targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

name: Invisibility
components: V, S, M (An eyelash encased in gum arabic.)
description: The touched creature becomes invisible until the spell ends. Everything it wears or carries becomes invisible too. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Knock
description: Choose a locked, barred, stuck, or magically sealed object within 60 feet (door, chest, manacles, etc.). It becomes unlocked and unbarred (one lock at a time if multiple locks). Arcane lock is suppressed for 10 minutes. A loud knock audible 300 feet away emanates from the target.

name: Lashing Vine
description: A magical vine bursts from the ground, wall, or ceiling in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It has AC and hit points equal to your spell save DC. When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, direct it to pull one Large or smaller creature within 30 feet: Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet toward the vine.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range and pull distance each increase by 10 feet per slot level above 2nd. At 4th level or higher, the vine can pull Huge or smaller creatures.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: Touch a creature to end one disease or one of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

name: Levitate
components: V, S, M (Either a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape with a long shank on one end.)
description: One creature or object (up to 500 lbs) within 60 feet rises up to 20 feet and remains suspended. Unwilling creatures make a Constitution saving throw to resist. The target can only move by pushing against fixed surfaces. You can alter its altitude by up to 20 feet on your turn (action if not the target). Floats gently down when the spell ends.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
components: V, S, M (A bit of fur from a bloodhound.)
description: Name or describe a specific kind of beast or plant. You learn the direction and distance to the nearest creature or plant of that type within 5 miles, if any are present.

name: Locate Object
description: Name or describe a familiar object. You sense its direction within 1,000 feet, and its direction of movement if moving. Can locate a specific known object (seen within 30 feet) or the nearest object of a particular type. Blocked by any thickness of lead.

name: Luminous Smite
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, deal +2d8 radiant damage. Until the spell ends, the target can't become invisible, isn't obscured by darkness spells, and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Lunar Beam
components: V, S, M (a small pearl or quartz disc)
description: Call down a 5-foot radius, 40-foot tall cylinder of moonlight at a point within 120 feet. Creatures starting their turn in or entering the beam make a Constitution saving throw: 2d10 radiant damage (half on success). Shapechangers and silver-vulnerable creatures make the save at disadvantage, take +1d10 on a failure, and can't change form while inside. As an action, move the beam up to 60 feet.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Magic Mouth
components: V, S, M (A small bit of honeycomb and jade dust worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Implant a message of 25 words or fewer in an object within 30 feet. Set a visual or audible trigger condition within 30 feet. When triggered, a magical mouth appears and recites the message in your voice at the same volume you spoke. Can trigger once and end, or repeat each time the trigger occurs.

name: Magic Weapon
description: Touch a nonmagical weapon. It becomes magical with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. At 6th level, the bonus increases to +3.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates appear in your space. When a creature attacks you, roll a d20 to determine if it hits a duplicate: 3 duplicates redirect on 6+; 2 duplicates on 8+; 1 duplicate on 11+. Duplicate AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier. A hit destroys that duplicate. Immune: creatures that can't see, use non-sight senses, or can perceive illusions as false.

name: Misty Step
description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
components: V, S, M (Several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar.)
description: A 5-foot radius, 40-foot tall cylinder of silvery dim light appears at a point within 120 feet. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the area make a Constitution saving throw: 2d10 radiant damage (half on success). Shapechangers have disadvantage; on a failed save, they instantly revert to original form and can't shapeshift while in the light. Action: move the beam up to 60 feet.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Muddy Servant
components: V, S, M (a pinch of earth and a drop of water)
description: Create a Medium mud golem in an unoccupied space within 30 feet (AC 12, 20 hp). It immediately attempts to grab one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet: Strength save or restrained and 2d6 bludgeoning damage. While within 30 feet, use an action to squeeze a restrained target (Strength save: 2d6 bludgeoning, half on success) or dissolve and reform anywhere in range to attempt a new grab. Restrained creatures escape with Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) vs. your spell save DC.

name: Oakenhide
description: Gain 6 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns. While you have these temp hp, your AC can be calculated as 15 + Dexterity modifier (maximum +2).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, your AC increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 2nd, and the temporary hit points gained per turn increase by 3 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Pass without Trace
components: V, S, M (Ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce.)
description: You and up to 10 chosen creatures within 30 feet gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour and can't be tracked except by magical means. No tracks or traces are left.

name: Phantasm
components: V, S, M (a small piece of lambs' wool)
description: One visible creature within 60 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or believe a debilitating phantasm is real. Choose one effect: Blinded; Restrained; Frightened; or Assailed (2d10 psychic damage at the start of each of its turns). The target repeats the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Up to six creatures you can see within 30 feet each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier hit points. No effect on undead or constructs.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Protection from Poison
description: Touch a creature. Neutralize one poison currently afflicting it (chosen or random if multiple). For 1 hour, the target has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

name: Psychic Skewer
description: One visible creature within 60 feet must make an Intelligence saving throw: 3d8 psychic damage (half on success). On failure, you also psychically link to its mind. For the duration, use a bonus action to subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw the target makes before the end of your next turn. While linked, you know the target's exact location, it can't be hidden from you, and it gains no benefit from invisibility against you.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: Make a ranged spell attack. Hit: the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw to end the effect.

name: Rope Trick
components: V, S, M (Powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment.)
description: Touch a rope up to 60 feet long. It rises and hangs vertically. At the top, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space holding up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. The rope can be pulled inside, hiding it. Attacks and spells can't cross the threshold, but those inside can see out through a 3×5-foot window. Everything drops out when the spell ends.

name: Scorching Ray
description: Create three rays of fire and hurl them at one or more targets within 120 feet. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray; each hit deals 2d6 fire damage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.

name: See Invisibility
components: V, S, M (A dash of talc and a small amount of silver powder.)
description: For 1 hour, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and can see into the Ethereal Plane. Ethereal creatures appear ghostly and translucent.

name: Shatter
components: V, S, M (A burst of mica.)
description: A painfully loud ringing erupts in a 10-foot radius sphere at a point within 60 feet. Creatures make a Constitution saving throw: 3d8 thunder damage (half on success). Creatures made of inorganic material (stone, crystal, metal) have disadvantage. Unattended nonmagical objects in the area also take the damage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Silence
description: No sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot radius sphere for 10 minutes. Creatures entirely inside are immune to thunder damage and deafened. Verbal spell components can't be used inside the sphere.

name: Spider Climb
components: V, S, M (A drop of bitumen and a spider.)
description: The touched willing creature gains the ability to move along vertical surfaces and upside down on ceilings (hands free), gaining a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

name: Spike Growth
components: V, S, M (Seven sharp spines or seven twigs cut peak.)
description: The ground in a 20-foot radius sprouts hard spikes and thorns, becoming difficult terrain for 10 minutes. Creatures take 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet moved through the area. The spikes are camouflaged; creatures that can't see the area must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) check vs. your spell save DC to recognize the hazard before entering.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: Create a floating spectral weapon within 60 feet. When you cast the spell, make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: 1d8 + spellcasting modifier force damage on a hit. Bonus action: move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Stream of Flame
components: V, S, M (a drop of oil)
description: Project a gout of flame in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw: 4d8 fire damage (half on success). Ignites flammable unattended objects.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 and the line extends by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Suggestion
components: V, M (A snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil.)
description: Suggest a course of action (one or two sentences) to one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound reasonable. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, it pursues the course of action for up to 8 hours or until completed. Ends if the target or its companions are attacked or harmed. Immune: creatures that can't be charmed.

name: Summon Animal Spirit
components: V, S, M (a set of fine animal statuettes, worth at least 200gp altogether)
description: Summon an Animal Spirit in an unoccupied space within 60 feet. Choose Earth, Sea, or Sky type. It is your ally, shares your initiative, takes its turn after yours, and obeys verbal commands. AC: 12 + spell level. HP: 15 (Sky) or 25 (Earth/Sea) + 5 per slot above 2nd. Attacks equal to half spell level. Earth: pack tactics, maul 1d6+3+level piercing. Sea: blood frenzy, water breathing, maul 1d6+3+level piercing. Sky: flyby, talons 1d4+1+level slashing.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the creature's AC, hit points, and attack damage increase as indicated in the stat block.

name: Touch of Filth
components: V, S, M (a piece of rotting food)
description: Make a melee spell attack. Hit: 1d6 poison damage and the target is poisoned. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw to end the poison. For the duration, you can repeat this attack each turn as an action.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Unbridled Fury
description: One humanoid within 120 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you. When you cast the spell and as an action on subsequent turns, activate its rage: it must move toward and make one melee attack against the nearest creature. If not activated or no creature is reachable, it acts normally. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target makes two melee attacks if it normally has the ability to make more than one attack on its turn.

name: Warding Bond
components: V, S, M (A pair of platinum rings worth at least 50gp each, which you and the target must wear for the duration.)
description: Touch a willing creature (both you and the target must wear matching platinum rings worth at least 50 gp each). While within 60 feet: target gains +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and resistance to all damage. Each time the target takes damage, you take the same amount. Ends if you drop to 0 hp, the target moves more than 60 feet away, or the spell is cast again on either of you.

name: Web
components: V, S, M (A bit of spiderweb.)
description: Fill a 20-foot cube with sticky webs at a point within 60 feet, lasting 1 hour. Creates difficult terrain, lightly obscured. Must be anchored between two solid masses or layered on a surface (5 ft deep) or it collapses. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the webs make a Dexterity saving throw or become restrained. Restrained creatures can escape with Strength check vs. your spell save DC. Webs burn: a 5-ft cube burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire damage.

name: Wellspring
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver watering can)
description: Create a 10-foot radius magical healing pool at a point within 30 feet. At any time (no action required), you may choose to restore 2d4 hit points to any creature in the pool, depleting the magic until the start of your next turn.
