higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Whirling Blades
components: V, S, M (a handful of metal shavings)
description: Create a 5-foot sphere of spinning metal shards at a point within 60 feet. Creatures take 4d4 slashing damage when entering or starting their turn there. As an action, launch the blades at a target within 30 feet: ranged spell attack for 4d4 piercing on a hit (half on a miss), then the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Zone of Truth
description: Create a 15-foot radius sphere at a point within 60 feet. Creatures entering or starting their turn there must make a Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak deliberate lies while inside. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails. Affected creatures are aware of the effect and may remain evasive or refuse to answer.

name: Animate Dead
components: V, S, M (A drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust.)
description: Create a skeleton (from bones) or zombie (from a Small or Medium humanoid corpse) within range. Bonus action to mentally command any creature you animated within 60 ft; issue the same command to all at once. If given no orders, it defends itself. Control lasts 24 hours; recast on the creature before that period ends to maintain control, also reasserting control over up to 4 previously animated creatures.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, animate or reassert control over 2 additional undead per slot above 3rd, each from a different corpse or pile of bones.

name: Arcane Shelter
components: V, S, M (a flake of tortoise shell)
description: Create a 10-ft-radius immobile dome of arcane energy centered on yourself for 8 hours; ends if you exit. Up to 10 Medium creatures (or fewer Large) fit inside. Designate up to 10 creatures who may pass through freely (25 ft movement cost); others cannot enter. Translucent from outside but blocks projectiles and all magical effects.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Choose any number of creatures within 30 ft. For 1 minute they have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regain the maximum HP possible from any healing.

name: Bestow Curse
description: Touch a creature; Wisdom save or cursed for 1 minute. Choose one: disadvantage on checks and saves for one ability score; disadvantage on attack rolls against you; Wisdom save each turn start or waste action; your attacks and spells deal +1d8 necrotic to target. Remove curse ends the effect. DM may allow alternatives of equivalent power.
higherLevel: At 4th: concentration, up to 10 minutes. At 5th: 8 hours (no concentration). At 7th: 24 hours. At 9th: until dispelled.

name: Blink
description: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20. On 11+, vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to within 10 ft of your departure point (or nearest unoccupied space). While ethereal: can see and hear the origin plane in gray tones to 60 ft; can only affect or be affected by other ethereal creatures. Dismiss as an action.

name: Brilliance
description: Spread a 60-ft-radius sphere of bright light (additional 60 ft dim) from a chosen point within 60 ft for 1 hour. Can be anchored to a held object; opaque cover blocks it. Dispels any darkness created by a spell of equal or lower level overlapping the area.

name: Call Lightning
description: Summon a storm cloud (10 ft tall, 60-ft radius) 100 ft above you for 10 minutes. When cast, and as an action on subsequent turns, call a bolt to any point within range: Dexterity save, 3d10 lightning (half on success) to all creatures within 5 ft. If cast outdoors in an existing storm, control it instead; damage increases by 1d10.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d10 per slot above 3rd.

name: Circle of Protection
components: V, S, M (a mixture of salt and silver powder worth at least 100gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Draw a 10-ft-radius glyph; a luminous 30-ft-tall cylinder rises from it for 1 hour. Choose a creature type (aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead). CR 5 or lower creatures of that type cannot willingly cross the boundary; attacks, spells, teleportation, or interplanar effects across the boundary require a Charisma save first. Can be made permanent (no concentration) with a 10-minute cast.
higherLevel: At 4th+: max affected CR increases by 3 per slot. Duration extends at higher slots (12 hrs at 5th-6th, 24 hrs at 7th-8th, permanent with no CR limit at 9th).

name: Clairvoyance
components: V, S, M (A focus worth at least 100gp, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing.)
description: Create an invisible sensor at a familiar or obvious location within 1 mile (10-minute cast). For 10 minutes, see or hear through it as if present there (choose sense on cast; switch with an action). A creature that can see magic perceives the sensor as a glowing intangible orb.

name: Command Beast
description: One beast within 60 ft: Wisdom save (advantage if fighting it; CR 4+ auto-succeeds) or charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, issue telepathic commands at no action cost. Use an action to take direct control until end of your next turn, using the beast's reaction by expending yours. Repeats Wisdom save each time it takes damage.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, there is no CR limit on the target.

name: Conjure Animals
description: Summon fey-spirit beasts in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft: 1 beast CR 2 or lower, 2 CR 1 or lower, 4 CR 1/2 or lower, or 8 CR 1/4 or lower. Roll group initiative; they obey verbal commands and defend themselves otherwise. Disappear at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
higherLevel: At 5th: twice as many; at 7th: three times; at 9th: four times as many.

name: Conjure Beast Pack
components: V, S, M (a handful of grain or corn)
description: Choose a Small or Tiny beast of CR 1/4 or lower; eight of that type (six if flying) appear around you. They share your initiative, acting after yours. Bonus action to command. When ordered to attack, make one melee spell attack per target: hit deals 1d4 bludgeoning/piercing + 1d4 per additional beast on the same target. Advantage if 3+ attack the same target; add spellcasting modifier to damage if 6+ attack the same target.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, summon 2 additional beasts per slot above 3rd.

name: Conjure Minor Fiends
components: V, S, M (100gp worth of incense mixed with humanoid blood, which is consumed in the casting)
description: Summon 2 Minor Fiends or fiends with combined CR 2 or lower. They share your initiative (act after yours), are friendly to you and hostile to others. If concentration breaks, they become hostile for 1 hour and cannot be dismissed. Each disappears at 0 HP. Minor Fiend stat block: AC 14, HP 32, Speed 30 ft; magic resistance; Claws +5 melee 1d8+3; Abyssal Bile (Charisma save or roll d4: frightened/poisoned/restrained/1d6 fire per turn).
higherLevel: When cast at higher levels, the number of Minor Fiends or combined CR of summoned fiends increases by 1 per slot above 3rd.

name: Counterspell
description: React to interrupt a spell being cast within 60 ft. Spells of 3rd level or lower automatically fail. For 4th level or higher, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + spell's level); on success, the spell fails.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, automatically counter spells of level equal to or lower than the slot used.

name: Create Food and Water
description: Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of clean water on the ground or in containers within 30 ft, sustaining up to 15 humanoids or 5 steeds for 24 hours. Food is bland and spoils after 24 hours if uneaten.

name: Daylight
description: 60-ft-radius sphere of bright light (additional 60 ft dim) spreads from a point within 60 ft for 1 hour. Can anchor to a held object (moves with it; opaque cover blocks it). Dispels darkness spells of 3rd level or lower that overlap the area. This light is not sunlight.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Target one creature, object, or magical effect within 120 ft. All spells of 3rd level or lower on it end automatically. For each spell of 4th level or higher, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + spell's level) to end it.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, automatically end spells of level equal to or lower than the slot used.

name: Erudition
components: V, S, M (a treatise worth at least 250 gp)
description: Gain proficiency in a chosen skill for 1 hour. Already proficient: gain expertise (double proficiency bonus). Already have expertise: reroll one die when rolling with advantage on checks using that skill. Ends early if recast.

name: Ethereal Slip
description: Roll a d20 at the end of each turn. On 11+, slip to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, returning to your departure point or nearest unoccupied space. Consecutive high or low rolls shift the d20 to 2d20 high or low. While ethereal: visible only to creatures with ethereal sight; perceive origin plane to 60 ft but cannot interact. Cannot cast while already ethereal.

name: False Death
components: V, S, M (a vial of corpse wax)
description: Touch a willing creature; it gains 10 temporary HP for 8 hours. As an action or reaction to being hit or taking damage, the target can appear dead to inspection and spells. While appearing dead: prone, full sight and hearing, resistance to all damage except psychic; ends if the target moves or takes an action, bonus action, or reaction. Diseases and poisons are suppressed while active. You can dismiss it as an action.

name: False Foes
components: V, S, M (a piece of a broken mirror)
description: One creature within 90 ft: Intelligence save (auto-success if immune to frightened) or it treats every other creature as an enemy for 1 minute, fighting them normally and making opportunity attacks against any that provoke one. Repeats save each time it takes damage.

name: Fear
components: V, S, M (A white feather or the heart of a hen.)
description: 30-ft cone; each creature: Wisdom save or drop held items and become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened: must Dash away each turn. If the creature ends its turn without line of sight to you, it may repeat the Wisdom save to end the effect.

name: Fiery Quiver
description: Enchant a quiver of ammunition; each piece drawn deals +2d6 fire damage on hit for 10 minutes. Only one piece is affected at a time. Ends after 6 pieces are used or if recast.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, the number of pieces of ammunition affected increases by 1 per slot above 3rd.

name: Fireball
components: V, S, M (A tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur.)
description: A point within 150 ft erupts in a 20-ft-radius sphere. Dexterity save: 8d6 fire damage (half on success). Ignites flammable unattended objects; spreads around corners.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Fireblast
components: V, S, M (a bit of peat and quicklime)
description: A point within 120 ft erupts in a 20-ft-radius sphere. Dexterity save: 7d6 fire damage (half on success). Ignites flammable unattended objects; spreads around corners.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Fly
components: V, S, M (A wing feather from any bird.)
description: Touch one willing creature; it gains a 60-ft fly speed for 10 minutes. Falls when the spell ends if still aloft (unless it can stop the fall).
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, target one additional creature per slot above 3rd.

name: Gaseous Form
components: V, S, M (A bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke.)
description: Transform a willing creature into a misty cloud for 1 hour (or until 0 HP). Movement: fly 10 ft only. Resistance to nonmagical damage; advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves; passes through cracks; cannot fall. Cannot speak, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells.

name: Glyph of Warding
components: V, S, M (Incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Inscribe a nearly invisible glyph (up to 10-ft diameter on a surface, or inside an object; breaks if object moves >10 ft) during a 1-hour cast. Intelligence (Investigation) vs your spell save DC to find. Set a trigger and choose: Explosive Runes (20-ft sphere, Dexterity save for 5d8 acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder damage), or Spell Glyph (store a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower targeting a creature; it triggers on the intruder and lasts its full duration).
higherLevel: At 4th+: Explosive Runes deals +1d8 per slot above 3rd. Spell Glyph: stored spell max level equals slot used.

name: Haste
components: V, S, M (A shaving of licorice root.)
description: One willing creature within 30 ft: speed doubled, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, plus one additional action per turn (Attack one weapon, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use Object only). When the spell ends, the target cannot move or act until after its next turn.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
components: S, M (A glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material.)
description: 30-ft cube within 120 ft. Each creature that sees the pattern: Wisdom save or become charmed (incapacitated, speed 0) for 1 minute. Effect ends on a creature that takes damage or is shaken awake (action by another creature).

name: Imbue Element
description: Touch a melee weapon; choose acid, cold, fire, or lightning. Deals +1d6 of that damage type on hit; base damage type also changes. Once per round when a creature takes this damage: Acid: +2d4 at end of its next turn; Cold: speed halved until end of its next turn; Fire: +1d6 immediately; Lightning: cannot take reactions until end of its next turn. Duration 1 hour.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, the bonus damage increases by 1d6 per 2 slots above 3rd.

name: Life Drain
description: Make ranged spell attacks against up to 3 non-construct, non-undead creatures within 30 ft. Hit: 3d6 necrotic damage each. Regain HP equal to half the total damage dealt.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per 2 slots above 5th.

name: Lightning Beam
components: V, S, M (a piece of quartz and a bit of fine dust)
description: A 100-ft line, 5 ft wide, from your fingertips. Can bounce once off a non-conductive solid surface. Dexterity save: 4d12 lightning damage (half on success). Ignites flammable unattended objects.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d12 per slot above 3rd.

name: Lightning Bolt
components: V, S, M (A bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass.)
description: A 100-ft line, 5 ft wide, blasts from you. Dexterity save: 8d6 lightning damage (half on success). Ignites flammable unattended objects.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Magic Circle
components: V, S, M (Holy water or powdered silver and iron worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Create a 10-ft-radius, 20-ft-tall cylinder of glowing magic from a ground point within 10 ft (1-minute cast, 1-hour duration). Choose one or more types: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. Chosen creatures cannot willingly enter; have disadvantage on attacks against targets inside; cannot charm, frighten, or possess targets within. Can reverse direction to trap chosen creatures inside and protect those outside.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, duration increases by 1 hour per slot above 3rd.

name: Major Image
components: V, S, M (A bit of fleece.)
description: Create a 20-ft-cube illusion (sight, sound, smell, temperature) at a point within 120 ft for 10 minutes. Move it with an action. Physical contact or a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your spell save DC reveals it as an illusion; aware creatures see through it.
higherLevel: When cast at 6th level or higher, the spell lasts until dispelled without requiring concentration.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: Bonus action. Up to 6 creatures of your choice within 60 ft each regain 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, healing increases by 1d4 per slot above 3rd.

name: Meld into Stone
description: Step into a stone surface large enough to contain you for 8 hours; undetectable by nonmagical senses. Inside: cannot see out, disadvantage on Perception to hear, can cast spells on yourself, cannot move. Exit through the entry point to end the spell. Minor stone damage does not harm you; major reshaping expels you (6d6 bludgeoning); destruction expels you (50 bludgeoning). Expelled: fall prone in nearest unoccupied space.

name: Necromantic Infusion
components: V, M (a handful of bone chips)
description: Target one creature within 60 ft. Living creature: Constitution save, 5d8 necrotic (half on success). Undead creature: gains 5d8 temporary HP and has advantage on attacks while they persist.

name: Nondetection
components: V, S, M (A pinch of diamond dust worth 25 gp sprinkled over the target, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a willing creature, place, or object (up to 10 ft in any dimension); hides it from all divination magic and magical scrying sensors for 8 hours.

name: Phantom Steed
description: Conjure a Large quasi-horse in an unoccupied space within 30 ft (1-minute cast, 1-hour duration). Speed 100 ft (10 mi/hr, 13 at fast pace). Equipment vanishes if carried more than 10 ft from the steed. Ends if steed takes damage or if dismissed as an action.

name: Plant Growth
description: Two modes. 1 action: all natural plants in a 100-ft radius around a chosen point become overgrown for the duration (4 ft movement cost per 1 ft moved); can exclude areas. 8 hours: enrich plants in a half-mile radius for 1 year (double food yield).

name: Power Word Nap
description: Command up to 3 willing prone creatures within 3 ft to sleep. Duration is one-fifth of a normal short rest (e.g., 12 minutes for a 1-hour rest). Ends early if a target takes damage or is shaken awake. If a target sleeps the full duration, it gains the benefit of a short rest and cannot use this spell again until after a long rest.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, target one additional willing creature per slot above 3rd.

name: Protection from Energy
description: Touch a willing creature; it gains resistance to one chosen damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) for 1 hour.

name: Reanimation
description: Raise a CR 2 or lower humanoid corpse or bone pile as a skeleton or zombie (applying the Skeleton or Zombie template). Bonus action to command up to your proficiency bonus minions within 60 ft. Control lasts 24 hours; recast to renew (also renews all current minions). Combined CR of minions cannot exceed 3; must wait 24 hours between creations.
higherLevel: At 4th+, max target CR and combined max CR increase by 1 per slot above 3rd. At 4th: also reanimate beasts; at 5th: giants or monstrosities.

name: Reanimation, Greater
description: Raise up to [proficiency bonus] creatures of CR 6 or lower as skeletons, zombies, or ghouls. Bonus action to command within 60 ft. Control lasts 24 hours; recast with no targets to renew all current minions (including those from Reanimation). Combined CR of all minions cannot exceed 10.
higherLevel: At 4th+, max target CR and combined max CR increase by 1 per slot above 3rd. At 4th: also reanimate beasts; at 5th: giants or monstrosities.

name: Remove Curse
description: End all curses on one creature or object. Cursed magic items retain their curse but attunement is broken so the item can be removed or discarded.

name: Revivify
components: V, S, M (Diamonds worth 300gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a creature that died within the last minute; it returns to life with 1 HP. Cannot restore missing body parts or reverse death by old age.

name: Riptide
description: Conjure a sudden wave in a 20-ft square on the ground or in water within 60 ft. Each creature: Strength save. Fail: 4d8 bludgeoning, knocked prone (Huge or smaller), and moved 15 ft in a chosen direction. Success: half damage only.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 and distance moved on a failed save increases by 5 ft per slot above 3rd.

name: Sending
components: V, S, M (A short piece of fine copper wire.)
description: Send a message of 25 words or fewer to any familiar creature, regardless of distance or plane. The target hears it mentally and can reply immediately. 5% chance of failure if on a different plane.

name: Siphon Life
description: One creature within 30 ft: Constitution save. Fail: loses 4d8 HP (unreducible); a second creature of your choice within 30 ft of the target regains that many HP. No effect on constructs or undead. Target can willingly fail the save.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Sleet Storm
components: V, S, M (A pinch of dust and a few drops of water.)
description: 20-ft-tall cylinder, 40-ft radius at a point within 150 ft for 1 minute. Heavily obscured; extinguishes exposed flames; ground becomes icy difficult terrain. Entering or starting a turn there: Dexterity save or fall prone. Concentrating creatures inside: Constitution save vs your DC or lose concentration.

name: Slow
components: V, S, M (A drop of molasses.)
description: Up to 6 creatures in a 40-ft cube: Wisdom save or for 1 minute: speed halved, -2 AC and Dexterity saves, no reactions, action or bonus action per turn (not both), max 1 attack per turn. If attempting a 1-action spell, roll d20; on 11+ the spell delays to next turn (use action to complete or lose it). Repeats Wisdom save at end of each turn.

name: Sonic Rift
description: Teleport to an unoccupied space within 90 ft. Can bring one willing same-or-smaller creature from within 5 ft (appears within 5 ft of destination; left behind if no space). After teleporting, choose starting or ending space: all other creatures within 10 ft make a Constitution save, 4d8 thunder damage (half on success). Audible to 300 ft.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Sparking Shot
components: V, S, M (a piece of ammunition or weapon worth at least 1 cp)
description: Imbue a piece of ammunition or weapon with electricity (bonus action, 1 round). On attack, the target and two chosen creatures within 15 ft make a Dexterity save: 3d12 lightning (half on success). If the attack hits, the original target automatically fails. Reverts to normal after use.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d12 per slot above 3rd.

name: Speak with Dead
description: Animate a corpse within 10 ft (must have a mouth; non-undead; not targeted in the past 10 days) for 10 minutes. Ask up to 5 questions. It answers with knowledge it had in life, usually briefly or cryptically, and is not compelled to answer honestly if hostile. The soul is not restored; it cannot learn new information or speculate.

name: Speak with Plants
description: Plants within 30 ft gain limited sentience for 10 minutes. Question them about events in the past day (creatures passing, weather, etc.). Convert plant-caused difficult terrain to ordinary terrain (or vice versa) for the duration. Can free creatures restrained by Entangle. Can communicate with plant creatures as if sharing a language (no magical influence over them).

name: Spectral Champion
description: Summon an incorporeal ghostly entity that envelops you for 1 minute. Choose cold, necrotic, or radiant. Your weapons deal +1d4 of that type on each hit; damaged creatures cannot regain HP until your next turn. When cast and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, the entity makes a melee spell attack within 10 ft: hit deals 2d8 damage, and the target makes a Wisdom save or its speed drops to 0 until the end of its next turn.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, the entity's attack damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Spell Glyph
components: V, S, M (silver powder worth at least 100gp, which the spell consumes)
description: Mark a fixed 5-ft-diameter surface with a nearly invisible arcane inscription (1-minute cast; lasts until dispelled or triggered). Intelligence (Investigation) vs your spell save DC to find; advantage with detect magic. Set trigger conditions and an optional password. Store a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower (1-action cast time, must target a non-caster creature or area) as part of casting. When triggered, it releases the stored spell targeting the intruder; concentration spells run their full duration.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, stored spell max level increases by 1 and material component cost increases by 50 gp per slot above 3rd.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Spirits swirl within 15 ft of you for 10 minutes. Designate any number of unaffected creatures. All other creatures: speed halved in the area. Entering or starting a turn there: Wisdom save or take 3d8 radiant (good/neutral) or necrotic (evil) damage (half on success).
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Spirit Remnant
components: V, S, M (a small heart-shaped piece of wood)
description: Perform a rite over a corpse within 10 ft (must have speech, non-undead, not targeted in past 10 days) for 10 minutes. Ask up to 5 questions; the spirit answers briefly and truthfully using knowledge from before its death. It will not lie or refuse to answer.

name: Spreadshot
description: 60-ft cone from self. Make a single ranged attack roll against each target in the cone: hit deals 4d8 damage (miss deals half). Damage type matches the weapon or ammunition used as a component.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 3rd.

name: Stinking Cloud
components: V, S, M (A rotten egg or several skunk cabbage leaves.)
description: 20-ft-radius sphere of nauseating yellow gas at a point within 90 ft for 1 minute. Heavily obscured; extinguishes exposed flames. Each creature entirely within the cloud at turn start: Constitution save vs poison or spends its action retching (cannot act). Creatures immune to poison or that need not breathe auto-succeed. Moderate wind (10+ mph) disperses after 4 rounds; strong wind (20+ mph) after 1 round.

name: Stone Pact
description: Touch a stone outcropping or wall and choose one option for 1 hour. Stone Meld: you and up to 7 Large-or-smaller willing creatures can meld into stone as an action; while inside: blind and deaf but tremorsense 30 ft; exit by action or ejected if stone is destroyed. Stone Armor: gain 10 temp HP and resistance to nonmagical damage while they persist. Stone Step: gain tremorsense 30 ft; immune to prone condition and forced movement while standing on the ground.

name: Summon Grave Spirit
components: V, S, M (a jeweled skull statuette worth at least 300gp)
description: Summon a Grave Spirit (Medium undead; AC 10 + spell level; proficiency equals yours) in a space within 60 ft for 1 hour. Choose Ethereal (fly 20 ft; passes through objects; Deathly Chill melee 1d4+2+level necrotic; Terrifying Grasp: Wisdom save or frightened), Ghoulish (walk 30 ft; Vile Claws melee 1d6+3+level slashing; Constitution save or poisoned/paralyzed), or Bone (walk 30 ft; Bone Arrow ranged 80/320 ft, 1d6+2+level piercing; Revive From Bones: on non-crit/non-radiant/non-bludgeoning/force reduction to 0 HP, bonus action revives at 1 HP). Shares your initiative, acts after yours, obeys verbal commands. Multiattack = spell level divided by 2 (rounded down).
higherLevel: At higher levels: HP = 15 (Ethereal) or 25 (Ghoulish/Bone) + 10 per slot above 3rd; all damage values scale with spell level.

name: Symbol of Resilience
description: Create a tiny symbol above you radiating hope in a 30-ft radius for 1 minute. Move it as a bonus action (30 ft). Non-hostile living creatures in the radius gain: advantage on Wisdom saves, add your spellcasting modifier to death saves (20 or higher counts as a natural 20), and regain maximum HP from any healing. The first time a creature starts its turn in the radius, it may expend 1 Hit Die as if taking a short rest (bonus action); if below half HP, also gain equal temp HP.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, a creature can spend one additional Hit Die per slot above 3rd.

name: Tiny Hut
components: V, S, M (A small crystal bead.)
description: Create a 10-ft-radius immobile dome of force for 8 hours. Up to 9 Medium creatures fit inside; fails if the area includes a larger creature or more than 9. Creatures inside when cast pass through freely; all others and spells/magical effects are blocked. Interior atmosphere is comfortable and dry; opaque from outside (any color), transparent from inside. Toggle interior dim lighting or darkness as desired.

name: Tongues
components: V, M (A small clay model of a ziggurat.)
description: Touch one creature; for 1 hour, it understands any spoken language it hears. When it speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear it understands what it says.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Melee spell attack within reach: 3d6 necrotic damage; regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. For 1 minute, repeat the attack as an action on each of your turns.
higherLevel: When cast at 4th level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per slot above 3rd.

name: Wall of Dust
components: V, S, M (a handful of dirt or sand)
description: Create a wall of blowing grit within 90 ft: up to 30 ft long, 10 ft high, 10 ft thick, for 10 minutes. Blocks line of sight; creatures inside are blinded and deafened. Entering or starting a turn in the wall: Strength save. Fail: each foot of movement costs 6 ft. Success: each foot costs 3 ft.

name: Water Breathing
components: V, S, M (A short piece of reed or straw.)
description: Grant up to 10 willing creatures in range the ability to breathe underwater for 24 hours. Affected creatures also retain normal breathing.

name: Water Walk
description: Grant up to 10 willing creatures in range the ability to move across any liquid surface (water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, lava) as if harmless solid ground for 1 hour. Lava can still deal heat damage. Submerged targets are carried to the surface at 60 ft per round.

name: Water Wall
components: V, S, M (a vial of pure water)
description: Create a wall of swirling water on ground within 60 ft: up to 30 ft long x 10 ft high x 5 ft thick, or a ring (15-ft diameter x 20 ft tall x 5 ft thick) for 10 minutes. Each foot costs 3 ft movement. Entering or starting a turn in the wall: Strength save, 2d6 bludgeoning (half on success). Ranged attacks through it: disadvantage, half damage. Fire extinguished; cold affects creatures within 5 ft of contact; lightning deals half damage to creatures in contact.

name: Wind Wall
components: V, S, M (A tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin.)
description: A wall up to 50 ft long x 15 ft high x 1 ft thick rises from the ground at a chosen point within 120 ft for 1 minute. When it appears, each creature in its area: Strength save, 3d8 bludgeoning (half on success). Blocks fog, smoke, and gases; stops Small-or-smaller flying creatures and objects; deflects ordinary projectiles (auto-miss); gaseous creatures cannot pass through.

name: Animal Transformation
components: V, S, M (a lump of clay)
description: Target a creature within 60 ft; Charisma save or transform for 1 hour (or until 0 HP). New form: any beast with CR equal to or less than the target's CR or level, maximum CR 4. Stats replaced by the beast's; retains alignment and personality. Cannot speak, cast spells, or use items. Assumes the new form's HP; excess damage on reversion carries over. Unwilling target may repeat the save at the end of each turn.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, the new form's maximum CR increases by 1 per slot above 4th.

name: Arcane Eye
components: V, S, M (A bit of bat fur.)
description: Create an invisible magical eye within 30 ft that hovers for 1 hour. Normal vision and darkvision 30 ft; can look in any direction. Move it up to 30 ft as an action; no maximum range from you. Cannot enter other planes; blocked by solid barriers but passes through 1-inch openings.

name: Assemble
description: Assemble up to 8 object-equivalents (Large = 8, Medium/Small = 1, Tiny = 1/8) from raw or partly-worked materials within 120 ft (metals, organics, plant matter, stone). Metal, stone, or mineral items max Medium. Cannot affect creatures or magic items; must have relevant artisan tool proficiency for quality work. Equivalent to 8 hours of crafting.

name: Banishment
components: V, S, M (An item distasteful to the target.)
description: Target one creature within 60 ft: Charisma save or banished for 1 minute. Native creature: sent to a harmless demiplane (incapacitated); returns when the spell ends unless concentration is maintained for the full minute. Extraplanar creature: sent home immediately; returns if the spell ends before 1 minute, otherwise stays permanently.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, target one additional creature per slot above 4th.

name: Bewilder
components: V, S, M (a sprig of wormwood)
description: 20-ft-radius sphere within range; each creature: Wisdom save or for 1 minute: cannot take reactions, spends half movement in a random direction (d8), rolls d4 each turn for behavior (1: stunned until next turn / 2: attacks all creatures as enemies / 3: frightened of all visible creatures / 4: drops held items, no movement or actions). Repeats save at end of each turn or when damaged.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, the sphere radius increases by 5 ft per slot above 4th.

name: Black Tentacles
components: V, S, M (A piece of tentacle from a giant octopus or a giant squid)
description: 20-ft square on ground within 90 ft filled with squirming tentacles for 1 minute; difficult terrain. Entering or starting a turn there: Dexterity save or 3d6 bludgeoning + restrained until spell ends. Restrained and starting turn there: 3d6 bludgeoning. Restrained creature: Strength or Dexterity check (action) vs your spell save DC to escape.

name: Blight
description: Target one creature within 30 ft: Constitution save, 8d8 necrotic (half on success). No effect on undead or constructs. Plant creatures and magical plants: disadvantage on save and maximum damage on failure. Nonmagical plants that are not creatures wither and die without a save.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 per slot above 4th.

name: Compulsion
description: Choose creatures that can hear you within 30 ft; Wisdom save (auto-success if immune to charm) or for 1 minute: each turn you designate a horizontal direction as a bonus action; affected creatures spend as much movement as possible in that direction, then may take actions before moving; Wisdom save after moving to end effect for that creature. Creatures will not move into obviously deadly hazards.

name: Confusion
description: 10-ft-radius sphere within 90 ft; each creature: Wisdom save or for 1 minute: cannot take reactions, rolls d10 each turn (1: move randomly, no action / 2-6: nothing / 7-8: melee attack a random adjacent creature / 9-10: act normally). Repeats Wisdom save at end of each turn.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, the sphere radius increases by 5 ft per slot above 4th.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: Summon elementals in unoccupied spaces within 90 ft (1-minute cast): 1 elemental CR 2 or lower, 2 CR 1 or lower, 4 CR 1/2 or lower, or 8 CR 1/4 or lower. Roll group initiative; they obey verbal commands and defend themselves otherwise. Disappear at 0 HP or spell end.
higherLevel: When cast at 6th level, twice as many; at 8th level, three times as many creatures appear (of the chosen option).

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
components: V, S, M (One holly berry per creature summoned.)
description: Summon fey creatures in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft: 1 fey CR 2 or lower, 2 CR 1 or lower, 4 CR 1/2 or lower, or 8 CR 1/4 or lower. Roll group initiative; they obey verbal commands and defend themselves otherwise. Disappear at 0 HP or spell end.
higherLevel: When cast at 6th level, twice as many; at 8th level, three times as many creatures appear.

name: Control Water
components: V, S, M (A drop of water and a pinch of dust.)
description: Control freestanding water in a 100-ft cube within 300 ft for 10 minutes; use an action each turn to maintain or switch effects. Flood: raise water level 20 ft; create a wave that carries and may capsize Huge-or-smaller vessels (25% chance). Part Water: create a trench across the area with water walls on each side. Redirect Flow: direct flowing water in any direction. Whirlpool (requires 50-ft-square, 25-ft-deep body): 5-ft base to 50-ft-top vortex; pull creatures within 25 ft toward it (Strength Athletics check to swim away); caught in vortex: 2d8 bludgeoning per turn, disadvantage to escape; objects take 2d8 per round.

name: Corrosive Burst
components: V, S, M (a handful of saltpeter and some copper shavings)
description: 20-ft-radius sphere at a point within 150 ft. Dexterity save: 8d4 acid damage (half on success). On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 4d4 acid damage at the end of each of its turns unless it or a creature within 5 ft spends an action to clear the acid. Lasts 1 minute.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, initial damage increases by 2d4 per slot above 4th.

name: Death Ward
description: Touch a creature; for 8 hours: the first time it would drop to 0 HP from damage, it drops to 1 HP instead (spell ends). If a death-without-damage effect would kill it, that effect is negated (spell ends).

name: Dimension Door
description: Teleport up to 500 ft to any spot you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction. Can bring one willing creature of your size or smaller within 5 ft. If the destination is occupied, you and your passenger each take 4d6 force damage and the teleport fails.

name: Divination
components: V, S, M (Incense and a sacrificial offering appropriate to your religion, together worth at least 25gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Contact your deity with an offering (25 gp). Ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity within 7 days; receive a truthful (possibly cryptic) reply. Does not account for future changes. Recasting before your next long rest incurs a cumulative 25% chance per casting of receiving a random reading (DM rolls secretly).

name: Dominate Beast
description: One beast within 60 ft: Wisdom save (advantage if fighting it) or charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, issue telepathic commands at no action cost. Use an action to take direct control until end of your next turn, using its reactions by spending yours. Repeats Wisdom save each time it takes damage.
higherLevel: At 5th: duration 10 minutes. At 6th: 1 hour. At 7th+: 8 hours.

name: Expose Weakness
description: One creature within 90 ft: Charisma save or lose resistance to one chosen non-BPS damage type for 1 minute. The first two times each round it takes that damage type, it takes +2d6 of that type.
higherLevel: When cast at 6th level or higher, the number of additional damage triggers per round increases by 1 per 2 slots above 4th.

name: Expulsion
components: V, S, M (an item the target abhors)
description: One creature within 60 ft: Charisma save. Fail: incapacitated and resistant to all damage (partly planar-shifted) for up to 1 minute; saves at end of each turn to end spell. An extraplanar creature that fails its second save disappears from the current plane; failing the third is permanently banished home (if concentration maintained full duration). Returns to its last space (or nearest unoccupied) on a successful save.
higherLevel: When cast at 5th level or higher, target one additional creature per slot above 4th.

name: Fabricate
description: Convert raw materials within 120 ft into finished goods of the same material (10-minute cast). Create up to a Large object (10-ft cube) or eight connected 5-ft-cube objects. Metal, stone, or minerals: Medium or smaller only. Quality matches raw materials. Cannot create creatures, magic items, or items requiring high craftsmanship without relevant artisan tool proficiency.

name: Faithful Hound
components: V, S, M (A tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone, and a thread)
description: Conjure an invisible phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space within 30 ft for 8 hours (or until dismissed or you move more than 100 ft away). Visible only to you; immune to harm. Barks at any Small-or-larger creature approaching within 30 ft without the password. Sees invisible; ignores illusions; perceives the Ethereal Plane. At the start of each of your turns, it bites one hostile creature within 5 ft (spell attack bonus = spellcasting modifier + proficiency), 4d8 piercing on hit.

name: Fire Shield
components: V, S, M (A little phosphorus or a firefly.)
description: Vaporous flames surround you for 10 minutes; bright light 10 ft, dim 10 ft beyond that. Choose a heat shield (resistance to cold) or cold shield (resistance to fire). When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d8 fire (heat) or cold (cold shield) damage. Dismiss as an action.

name: Freedom of Movement
components: V, S, M (A leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage.)
description: Touch one willing creature for 1 hour: difficult terrain does not impede movement; cannot be paralyzed or restrained by spells or magical effects; speed cannot be magically reduced; spend 5 ft of movement to auto-escape nonmagical restraints; no underwater movement or attack penalties.

name: Giant Insect
description: Transform up to 10 centipedes, 3 spiders, 5 wasps, or 1 scorpion within 30 ft into their giant versions for 10 minutes. They obey your verbal commands and act on your turn. Revert when the spell ends, at 0 HP, or when dismissed as an action.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: You or a touched creature becomes invisible for 1 minute, along with all worn and carried gear. Invisibility persists even while attacking or casting spells.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: Conjure a Large spectral guardian in an unoccupied space within 30 ft for 8 hours. The first time each turn a hostile creature moves to within 10 ft of it: Dexterity save, 20 radiant damage (half on success). The guardian vanishes after dealing a total of 60 damage.

name: Hailstorm
components: V, S, M (a piece of onion and a droplet of water)
description: Balls of ice slam down in a 20-foot radius, 40-foot high cylinder centered on a point within range for the duration. The area becomes difficult terrain. Each creature starting its turn in the cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 bludgeoning and 5d4 cold damage on a fail, or half on a success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 5th-level slot or higher, both bludgeoning and cold damage each increase by 1d4 per slot above 4th, and the radius and height each increase by 5 feet per slot above 4th.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
components: V, S, M (A stone, a twig, and a bit of green plant.)
description: Natural terrain in a 150-foot cube within range appears as different natural terrain of your choice (sound and smell included) for 24 hours. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures are unaffected. The illusion doesn't hold to touch. A creature that examines the area can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it; on success, the illusion appears as a vague image overlaid on reality.

name: Ice Storm
components: V, S, M (A pinch of dust and a few drops of water.)
description: Hail pounds a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder within range. Creatures in the cylinder make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage on a fail, or half on a success. Hailstones turn the area into difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Irradiate
description: A 30-foot radius sphere of pulsating blue light appears and lasts 10 minutes. When a creature first enters or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw (constructs auto-succeed). On failure: hit point maximum reduced by 7d4, speed reduced by 5 feet, and -2 penalty to attacks, checks, saves, and save DCs. It also emits light in a 5-foot radius and can't benefit from invisibility. These debuffs accumulate with each failed save. Five failures kills the creature. All effects (except death) end when the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the hit point maximum reduction increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Locate Creature
components: V, S, M (A bit of fur from a bloodhound.)
description: Describe or name a familiar creature. While within 1,000 feet, you sense its direction; if moving, you know its direction of movement. Can locate a specific known creature or the nearest creature of a type you've seen within 30 feet. Doesn't work if the target is polymorphed, or if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you.

name: Phantasmal Horror
description: Create an illusion of a creature's worst nightmares visible only to it. At the start of each of the target's turns, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a fail, it takes 4d10 psychic damage and is frightened. On a success, the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: Tap into a creature's deepest fears, manifesting an illusion visible only to it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw; on fail, it's frightened for the duration. At the start of each of its turns, the target makes another Wisdom save or takes 4d10 psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Polymorph
description: Transform a creature within range into a beast with CR equal to or less than the target's CR or level. Unwilling targets make a Wisdom saving throw; shapechangers auto-succeed. The target uses the beast's statistics but retains alignment and personality. It can't speak, cast spells, or use equipment (gear melds into the new form). The target gains the beast's hit points; on revert, it returns to its pre-transform HP total. Excess damage on revert carries over. Lasts up to 1 hour or until the target drops to 0 HP.

name: Private Sanctum
components: V, S, M (A thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite.)
description: Magically secure a cube 5–100 feet per side within range for 24 hours. Choose any combination of the following: sound can't cross the barrier; vision and darkvision are blocked through the barrier; divination sensors can't appear inside or cross the perimeter; creatures inside can't be targeted by divination; teleportation and planar travel are blocked inside. Cast daily in the same spot for one year to make it permanent.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, cube size increases by 100 feet for each slot level above 4th.

name: Resilient Sphere
components: V, S, M (A hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemispherical piece of gum arabic.)
description: A sphere of force encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range. Unwilling creatures make a Dexterity saving throw; on fail, they're enclosed. The sphere is immune to all damage; nothing passes through in either direction, though creatures inside can breathe. The enclosed creature can roll the sphere at half its speed; other creatures can carry it. Disintegrate destroys the sphere without harming occupants.

name: Rot
description: Blast a creature with necrotic energy. Constitution save: 9d8 necrotic plus disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until end of your next turn on fail; half damage only on success. Constructs and undead auto-succeed; plants have disadvantage.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Secret Chest
components: V, S, M (An exquisite chest, 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet, constructed from rare materials worth at least 5,000 gp, and a Tiny replica made from the same materials worth at least 50 gp.)
description: Hide a chest (up to 12 cubic feet) on the Ethereal Plane by touching it and its tiny replica. Touch the replica to recall it; touch both chest and replica to send it back. After 60 days, cumulative 5% chance per day the effect ends. If on the Ethereal Plane when the effect ends, the chest is irretrievably lost.

name: Stone Shape
components: V, S, M (Soft clay, to be crudely worked into the desired shape for the stone object.)
description: Touch a Medium or smaller stone object or a stone section no more than 5 feet in any dimension and reshape it. Can create passages through walls up to 5 feet thick, seal doors, or form simple objects with up to two hinges and a latch. Finer mechanical detail is not possible.

name: Stoneskin
components: V, S, M (Diamond dust worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, it has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Stormcloud
description: A 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder of storm appears, moving up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice at the start of each of your turns. The area is difficult terrain, lightly obscured, and creatures inside are deafened. As a bonus action, direct a lightning strike at one creature within 60 feet of the center: ranged spell attack with advantage if the target is inside, dealing 2d12 lightning on a hit. Afterward, all creatures in the area make a Constitution save: 4d8 thunder on fail, half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, thunder damage increases by 1d8 and lightning damage increases by 1d12 for every two slot levels above 4th.

name: Summon Golem
components: V, S, M (a stone or iron statuette worth at least 400gp)
description: Conjure a Golem Spirit (Flesh, Stone, or Iron) in an unoccupied space within range. It's your ally, shares your initiative, and acts after yours. It obeys verbal commands; without orders, it Dodges. Stats by type and slot level: AC 11+level (Flesh) or 13+level (Iron/Stone). HP: 50+15/level above 4th (Flesh) or 35+10/level (Iron/Stone). Str 18. Multiattack: (level/2, rounded down) Slam attacks (1d8+4+level bludgeoning). Flesh: immune to lightning, berserk when below half HP (advantage on attacks, loses 5 HP/turn if it doesn't attack). Stone: once per turn, hit creature makes Wis save or speed halved, loses reactions. Iron: immune to fire; Poisonous Gas action (5-ft radius Con save, 1d12+level poison, poisoned until end of next turn).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the golem's AC, HP, and attack damage increase as described in the stat block.

name: Synaptic Spear
description: Launch a spear of psychic energy at a creature within range. Intelligence save: 6d8 psychic damage plus blinded and deafened until end of your next turn on fail; half damage only on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Unerring Sentry
description: Conjure an invisible magical sentry in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, lasting 8 hours or until dismissed. It alerts you when any CR 1/4+ non-ally enters within 60 feet. It sees invisible creatures, sees into the Ethereal Plane, and can't be fooled by illusions. As an action, direct it to move up to 30 feet and make a melee spell attack (4d8 force on hit). Without commands, it attacks the nearest non-ally within range.

name: Wall of Fire
components: V, S, M (A small piece of phosphorus.)
description: Create a wall of fire (up to 60 ft long, 20 ft high, 1 ft thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 ft diameter) on a solid surface within range. When the wall appears, creatures within make a Dexterity save: 5d8 fire on fail, half on success. One designated side deals 5d8 fire damage to creatures ending their turn within 10 feet of it, entering it, or starting their turn there.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Whirling Water
components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
description: Create a 10-foot radius swirling ball of water on ground or in water within range. Creatures entering or starting a turn in it make a Strength save or are restrained; they retry at the start of each turn. As an action, roll the sphere up to 30 feet (dousing nonmagical flames). If a restrained creature collides with a creature outside, both take 4d6 bludgeoning. As a bonus action, hurl a restrained creature 20 feet in any direction (4d6 bludgeoning; collision target Dex save or same). When the spell ends, restrained creatures fall prone and fires within 20 feet are extinguished.

name: Animate Objects
description: Animate up to 10 nonmagical objects within range (Medium = 2, Large = 4, Huge = 8 objects; nothing larger than Huge). They last until the spell ends or drop to 0 HP. Bonus action: command any within 500 feet. Stats by size — Tiny: 20 HP, AC 18, +8 to hit, 1d4+4; Small: 25 HP, AC 16, +6, 1d8+2; Medium: 40 HP, AC 13, +5, 2d6+1; Large: 50 HP, AC 10, +6, 2d10+2; Huge: 80 HP, AC 10, +8, 2d12+4. All have blindsight 30 ft. Without orders, objects defend themselves.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, animate 2 additional objects for each slot level above 5th.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A 10-foot-radius barrier moves with you, barring living creatures (not undead or constructs) from entering or reaching through. If you move so that a blocked creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

name: Arcane Hand
components: V, S, M (An eggshell and a snakeskin glove.)
description: Create a Large force hand (AC 20, HP equal to your maximum, Str 26/+8, Dex 10/+0) that moves 60 feet as a bonus action each turn. Choose one effect per turn: Clenched Fist — melee spell attack for 4d8 force; Forceful Hand — Strength contest to push (advantage if target is Medium or smaller); Grasping Hand — grapple attempt (advantage if Medium or smaller), bonus action to crush for 2d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning; Interposing Hand — stay between you and a target, granting you half cover (blocks movement if target's Strength is at or below the hand's).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, fist damage increases by 2d8 and grapple crush damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Arcane Wall
components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered gemstone)
description: Create an invisible force wall in any orientation: up to ten contiguous 10-foot panels, or a dome or sphere up to 10 feet in radius; 1/4 inch thick. Creatures in the wall's space when it appears are pushed aside. Nothing passes through (physically or ethereally). Each panel has AC 15 and 100 HP; immune to psychic and nonmagical physical damage, can't be dispelled by dispel magic. Disintegrate destroys it instantly. Extends into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Awaken
components: V, S, M (An agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant with Int 3 or less (requires 8-hour casting with a 1,000 gp agate, consumed). It gains Int 10 and learns one language you know. Plants gain mobility and human-like senses. The awakened creature is charmed by you for 30 days; on that condition's end, it chooses whether to remain friendly based on how you treated it.

name: Blazing Blade
description: Touch a weapon; for 10 minutes it deals +1d6 fire and +1d6 radiant per hit, with base damage changed to fire or radiant (your choice). Sunfire Swipe (bonus action, ends spell): 30-foot cone, Dexterity save (undead and fiends at disadvantage). Fail: 3d6 fire + 3d6 radiant, plus holy fire for 1 minute (attacks against creature have advantage, it can't benefit from invisibility; Wisdom save each turn to end). Success: half damage only. The weapon and any creature with holy fire shed bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 feet.

name: Cloudkill
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow-green poison fog appears, heavily obscuring the area. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the fog, it makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison on fail, half on success (even if holding breath or not needing to breathe). The fog moves 10 feet away from you each turn, sinking to lower ground. Strong wind disperses it.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Command Objects
description: Animate up to 6 nonmagical objects of the same size (max one Huge). In combat, they share your initiative and act after yours. As a bonus action, command any number within range to attack or perform another action; otherwise they Dodge. Stats by size — Tiny: 5 HP, AC 19, Str 12, Dex 28, 1d4+1 (fly hover 30); Small: 10 HP, AC 18, Str 16, Dex 24, 1d6+3 (fly 30); Medium: 20 HP, AC 17, Str 20, Dex 20, 1d10+5 (30); Large: 30 HP, AC 16, Str 24, Dex 16, 2d10+7 (25); Huge: 60 HP, AC 15, Str 28, Dex 12, 5d12+9 (20). Attack bonus equals your spell attack modifier.

name: Commune
components: V, S, M (Incense and a vial of holy or unholy water.)
description: Contact your deity or a divine proxy to ask up to 3 yes/no questions, receiving correct answers (or "unclear" if unknown). Casting twice or more before finishing a long rest gives each casting after the first a cumulative 25% chance to receive no answer (DM rolls secretly).

name: Commune with Nature
description: Briefly attune to nature in a 3-mile radius outdoors (300 feet in natural underground settings). Learn up to 3 facts about: terrain and bodies of water; prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples; powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead; planar influences; or buildings. Doesn't function in constructed areas such as dungeons or towns.

name: Cone of Cold
components: V, S, M (A small crystal or glass cone.)
description: A blast of cold erupts from your hands in a 60-foot cone. Constitution save: 8d8 cold on fail, half on success. Creatures killed by this spell become frozen statues until they thaw.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Conjure Elemental
components: V, S, M (Burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water.)
description: Call an elemental of CR 5 or lower appropriate to a 10-foot cube of air, earth, fire, or water within range. It's friendly, obeys verbal commands (no action required), and has its own turns. If concentration breaks, you lose control — it becomes hostile and can't be dismissed, disappearing 1 hour after summoning.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating limit increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: Make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. Fail: 6d6 psychic damage and insanity until a long rest (can't take actions, can't read, speaks only gibberish; greater restoration ends it). Success: ask an extraplanar entity up to 5 questions, receiving one-word answers such as yes, no, maybe, never, irrelevant, or unclear.

name: Contagion
description: Melee spell attack. On a hit, afflict the target with a disease of your choice: Blinding Sickness (Wis disadvantage on checks/saves, blinded), Filth Fever (Str disadvantage on checks/saves/attacks), Flesh Rot (Cha disadvantage, vulnerable to all damage), Mindfire (Int disadvantage, confused in combat), Seizure (Dex disadvantage on checks/saves/attacks), or Slimy Doom (Con disadvantage, stunned until end of next turn when taking damage). At end of each of target's turns: Constitution save. Three successes ends the spell; three failures locks in the disease for 7 days.

name: Corpse Puppets
description: Reanimate up to 5 Tiny/Small/Medium corpses (CR 1/4+) within range as Skeletons or Zombies. They share your initiative, act after yours, and follow bonus-action commands. Without orders they Dodge; on spell end, they become inanimate. Skeleton: AC 13, 15 HP, multiattack (2×1d6+1 slashing). Zombie: AC 8, 25 HP, 2d4+2 bludgeoning; Festering Fortitude (Con save to drop to 1 HP instead of 0); Seizing Swarm (advantage on grapples with allied zombie nearby).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, animate 2 additional corpses for each slot level above 5th.

name: Creation
components: V, S, M (A tiny piece of matter of the same type of the item you plan to create.)
description: Create a nonliving object of vegetable or mineral matter up to a 5-foot cube. Duration by material: vegetable 1 day, stone/crystal 12 hours, precious metals 1 hour, gems 10 minutes, adamantine/mithral 1 minute. If composed of multiple materials, use the shortest duration. Using created material as a spell component causes that spell to fail.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the cube increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 5th.

name: Devil Binding
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood and an obsidian chalice worth at least 665 gp)
description: Summon a devil of CR 4-8 (or by true name regardless of CR) in an unoccupied space within range. It won't harm you for the duration and obeys reasonable commands, fighting ruthlessly but retreating to preserve itself. After 10 minutes, it may ignore commands and pursue its own goals. If concentration is maintained for the full hour, you may return it; otherwise it remains indefinitely.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the devil's possible CR increases by 2 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
components: V, S, M (Holy water or powdered silver and iron.)
description: Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either special function: Break Enchantment (action) — touch a creature to end any charm, fear, or possession on it caused by those types. Dismissal (action) — melee spell attack against one such creature; on a hit, it makes a Charisma save or is banished to its home plane (undead go to Shadowfell, fey to Feywild).

name: Disrupting Smite
description: Your next melee weapon attack before the spell ends deals +5d10 force damage. The target makes a Charisma save. On fail: incapacitated and resistant to all damage until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save; success ends the effect.

name: Dominate Person
description: One humanoid within range makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you're in combat with it). On fail, it's charmed for 1 minute with a telepathic link. Issue mental commands as a free action; use your action for total control until end of your next turn, optionally using its reaction (costs yours). Taking damage triggers a new Wisdom save; success ends the spell.
higherLevel: Duration extends to 10 minutes (6th level), 1 hour (7th), or 8 hours (8th and higher).

name: Dream
components: V, S, M (A handful of sand, a dab of ink, and a writing quill plucked from a sleeping bird.)
description: You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance as messenger. While the target sleeps on the same plane, the messenger appears in its dreams to converse and shape the dream environment. If awake, the messenger can wait for the target to fall asleep. Optional nightmare mode: deliver a message up to 10 words, then target makes a Wisdom save (disadvantage if you have a body part). Fail: no rest benefit and 3d6 psychic damage on waking.

name: Drink Life
description: Extend a necrotic tendril to a creature within 60 feet. Constitution save: 6d8 necrotic plus speed halved until your next turn on fail, half damage on success. You regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. Each turn for the duration, use your action to repeat the effect against any creature within range.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Earth Forming
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver pickaxe)
description: Command soft earth (sand, dirt, clay) to reshape itself. As an action, permanently modify up to a 20-foot cube within range, moving it up to 20 feet over 5 minutes to create or destroy terrain features (trenches, pillars, ramps, walls). One area at a time; unfinished work slowly reverts. Can't affect stone, metal, or hard materials. As a ritual (500 gp silver pickaxe consumed), effect is enhanced.

name: Flame Strike
description: A column of divine fire erupts in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder within range. Dexterity save: 4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant on fail, half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, fire or radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Flickering Strikes
components: V, S, M (a melee weapon you are proficient with worth at least 1 sp)
description: Brandish your weapon and teleport to strike up to 5 targets within 30 feet, making a melee weapon attack against each. On a hit, deal weapon damage + 6d6 force. After attacking, teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of any target.

name: Geas
description: Command a creature that can understand you within range (Wisdom save). On fail, charmed for 30 days. While charmed, acting contrary to your instructions deals 5d10 psychic damage (once per day). Issue any command except one causing certain death; suicidal commands end the spell. Remove curse, greater restoration, or wish ends it.
higherLevel: Duration extends to 1 year (7th or 8th level) or until dispelled (9th level).

name: Greater Restoration
components: V, S, M (Diamond dust worth at least 100gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Imbue a touched creature with positive energy to end one of: 1 exhaustion level, 1 charm or petrify effect, 1 curse (including cursed item attunement), 1 ability score reduction, or 1 hit point maximum reduction.

name: Hallow
components: V, S, M (Herbs, oils, and incense worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Infuse an area up to 60-foot radius with holy or unholy power. Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead can't enter or charm/frighten/possess creatures within (you may exclude types). Choose one extra effect: Courage (can't be frightened), Darkness (magical darkness, blocks lower-level lights), Daylight (bright light, blocks lower-level magical darkness), Energy Protection or Vulnerability (resistance or vulnerability to one non-physical damage type), Everlasting Rest (no undead reanimation), Extradimensional Interference (no teleportation), Fear (all affected are frightened), Silence, or Tongues (universal communication). Creatures can Charisma save to ignore the extra effect on entry. Cast daily for a year to make permanent.

name: Hold Monster
components: V, S, M (A small piece of iron.)
description: One creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw or is paralyzed for the duration. No effect on undead. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; success ends the spell.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 6th-level slot or higher, target one additional creature per slot level above 5th. All targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

name: Holy Fire
components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash from burnt incense)
description: A column of holy fire strikes a 40-foot-high, 10-foot-radius cylinder within range. Choose fire damage, radiant damage, or both. Dexterity save: 8d8 of the chosen type (or 4d8 of each if both) on fail, half on success. No benefit from cover for this save.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, damage increases by 2d8 (or 1d8 of each type) for every two slot levels above 5th.

name: Incinerate
description: Wreath a creature in magical flame. At the start of each of its turns, it makes a Dexterity save: 10d6 fire on fail (and spell continues); spell ends for it on success. It sheds bright light 30 feet, dim 30 feet. As a bonus action, spread the flames from any burning target to another creature within 10 feet. A creature reduced to 0 HP is turned to ash.

name: Inflict Disease
description: Melee spell attack. On a hit, choose one disease (no effect on constructs, undead, or disease-immune; only heal or equivalent can cure): Muscle Weakness (Str disadvantage, half Str damage), Trembling Spasms (Dex disadvantage, half Dex damage), Skinslough (Con disadvantage, speed 10 ft on taking damage), Mindrot (Int disadvantage, can't tell friend from foe), Fire-eyes Fever (Wis disadvantage, blinded), or Flesh Rot (Cha disadvantage, +5 damage from physical hits). Constitution save at end of each turn: three successes ends it; three failures locks in the disease for 7 days.

name: Injunction
description: Charm a creature that understands you within range (Wisdom save). While charmed, violating your instructions reduces its current and maximum HP by 5d10 once per turn. Issue any command except suicidal ones. Remove curse (at the spell's level) ends the spell; greater restoration ends only the HP reduction. The creature's death doesn't end the spell.
higherLevel: HP reduction increases by 1d10 per slot above 5th. Duration extends to 1 year (7th or 8th level) or until dispelled (9th).

name: Insect Plague
components: V, S, M (A few grains of sugar, some kernels of grain, and a smear of fat.)
description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of biting locusts appears, lasting 10 minutes. The area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. When the sphere appears and when a creature enters or ends its turn there, it makes a Constitution save: 4d10 piercing on fail, half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Legend Lore
components: V, S, M (Incense worth 250 inches that fate consumes and four sticks of ivory worth 50 gp each.)
description: Name or describe a person, place, or object. If it has legendary importance, the spell brings to mind a brief summary of significant lore — current tales, forgotten stories, or secret knowledge. The more information you already have, the more precise the result. Information is accurate but may be figurative or cryptic.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Up to 6 creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet each regain 3d8 + spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Mass Freeze
description: Drain warmth from a 20-foot-radius sphere within range. Constitution save: 4d8 cold damage to all in the area on fail, half on success. Failed targets are restrained (encased in ice), taking 1d8 cold at the start of each of their turns. Constitution save at end of each turn to break free.

name: Misdirection
description: As an action or reaction (when hit), turn invisible and create an illusory double in your space. The double mimics your movement and actions; your attacks and spells appear to come from it and it has your AC. If a creature damages the double or perceives it attacking, it makes an Investigation check (DC = your spell save DC); success reveals the illusion and you become visible to that creature. As an action, see and hear through the double's senses, blinded and deafened to your own surroundings until you switch back.

name: Mislead
description: Turn invisible while an illusory double of you appears where you stand. The double lasts for the duration; your invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell. Use your action to move the double up to twice your speed and control its behavior. You can see and hear through the double's senses; bonus action to switch between its senses and your own (while using its senses, you're blinded and deafened to your surroundings).

name: Modify Memory
description: One visible creature makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you're in combat with it). On fail: charmed and incapacitated for 1 minute, still able to hear you. While charmed, modify its memory of one event from the last 24 hours lasting 10 minutes or less: eliminate it, sharpen it, change its details, or implant a false memory. Speak the modification aloud; the target must understand you. Contradictory or nonsensical memories may be dismissed. Remove curse or greater restoration restores true memory.
higherLevel: Modifiable event extends back to 7 days (6th), 30 days (7th), 1 year (8th), or any time (9th).

name: Morph Earth
components: V, S, M (a handful of rice and water)
description: Transform up to a 40-foot cube of earth with one effect. Create Mud: rock and dirt become mud; each foot of movement costs 4 feet. Creatures on the ground when cast, entering, or ending their turn there make a Strength save or are restrained (action by the creature or someone within 5 ft to end). Create Rock: wet earth less than 10 feet deep hardens. Creatures inside make a Dex save: success moves them to the surface; fail leaves them restrained (Str Athletics check vs. your spell save DC to free). Rock: AC 15, 25 HP, immune to poison and psychic.

name: Nature's Fury
description: All terrain within 60 feet is difficult terrain (except for chosen allies) for the duration. When cast and as a bonus action each subsequent turn, choose one effect at a point within 60 feet: Trees — creatures within 10 feet, Dex save or 6d6 slashing; Roots — 10-foot radius, Str save or restrained (ally within 5 ft, Str Athletics check to free); Rocks — ranged spell attack, 6d10 bludgeoning + knocked prone on a hit (Large or smaller); Wind — 60-ft line 20 ft wide, Str save or pushed 25 feet in wind direction and knocked prone.

name: Nature's Protection
description: A 10-foot-radius aura centered on you provides three-quarters cover and difficult terrain to creatures other than you, moving with you. As a bonus action (or reaction when a creature enters the aura), surge the elements: Large or smaller creatures inside make a Strength save or are pushed out of the aura to the nearest unoccupied space; fail also knocks them prone.

name: Necromantic Storm
components: V, M (a piece of tattered black silk)
description: Tear a rift to the plane of death at a point within range. All non-undead creatures within 10 feet make a Constitution save: 6d8 necrotic on fail, half on success. If a creature dies, the blast spreads to a 10-foot radius around it. No creature can be damaged twice; the spell ends after affecting 10 creatures total. Humanoids killed by the spell rise as zombies at the start of your next turn, attacking the nearest living creature.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the maximum creatures affected increases by 2 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Passwall
components: V, S, M (A pinch of sesame seeds.)
description: Create a passage up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep through a wooden, plaster, or stone surface for 1 hour. No structural instability. When the passage closes, any creatures or objects inside are safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space on the surface side where the spell was cast.

name: Planar Binding
components: V, S, M (A jewel worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Attempt to bind a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within range (1-hour casting). Charisma save: on fail, it serves you for 24 hours, following your instructions to the best of its ability (may twist words if hostile). If it was summoned by another spell, that duration extends to match. If it completes your orders and you're on the same plane, it reports back.
higherLevel: Duration extends to 10 days (6th), 30 days (7th), 180 days (8th), or 1 year and 1 day (9th).

name: Psychokinesis
description: Mentally move a creature or object within range. Creature (Huge or smaller): Strength save (may fail willingly); fail = moved up to 30 feet and restrained until end of your next turn (hovering in midair if lifted). Object (up to 1,000 lbs): if uncarried, move up to 30 feet freely; if worn or carried, Str save or pull it away and move it 30 feet. Each turn, use an action to repeat the effect against the same or a new target.

name: Raise Dead
components: V, S, M (A diamond worth at least 500gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Return a creature dead 10 days or fewer to life at 1 HP, provided its soul is willing and free. Neutralizes poisons and nonmagical diseases present at death. Doesn't remove magical diseases, curses, or similar effects. Doesn't restore missing body parts; fails if head or vital organ is absent. After return, the creature suffers a -4 penalty to attacks, saves, and ability checks, reducing by 1 each long rest until gone.

name: Reincarnate
components: V, S, M (Rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Touch a dead humanoid (or piece of one) dead 10 days or fewer. A new adult body forms and the soul enters it (fails if soul is unwilling or not free). The DM rolls d100 for the new race: 01-04 Dragonborn, 05-13 Hill Dwarf, 14-21 Mountain Dwarf, 22-25 Dark Elf, 26-34 High Elf, 35-42 Wood Elf, 43-46 Forest Gnome, 47-52 Rock Gnome, 53-56 Half-elf, 57-60 Half-orc, 61-68 Lightfoot Halfling, 69-76 Stout Halfling, 77-96 Human, 97-00 Tiefling. Creature retains all memories and capabilities, exchanging racial traits for the new race.

name: Sacred Circle
components: V, S, M (a piece of turquoise mounted in silver)
description: Create a 60-foot-radius, 120-foot-tall cylinder of planar energy. Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attacks against three chosen creatures within it. As an action, remove any charm, fear, or possession effects (from those creature types) from one creature inside. You choose whether to allow or block teleportation, interplanar travel, and summoning within the cylinder.

name: Scrying
components: V, S, M (A focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water.)
description: Observe a creature on the same plane (Wisdom save with modifiers: secondhand +5, firsthand +0, familiar -5; likeness or picture -2, possession or garment -4, body part -10).
