On fail, an invisible sensor appears within 10 feet of the target, moving with it for the duration. You see and hear through it. A success means you can't use this casting on that target again for 24 hours. Alternatively, target a previously seen location; the sensor appears there stationary. Creatures that see invisible objects see the sensor as a glowing orb.

name: Seeming
description: Change the appearance of any number of visible creatures within range (unwilling: Charisma save). Each can appear up to 1 foot taller or shorter, different in build, and with altered clothing, armor, and equipment. Body type (limb arrangement) can't change. The illusion fails to hold up to physical touch. A creature examining a target can make an Investigation check (DC = your spell save DC) to see through it.

name: Shape Winds
description: Control air in a cube up to 300 feet on a side within range for 1 hour. Use an action to change or pause the effect. Gale: steady directional wind — moving against costs 2 extra feet, ranged attacks against it auto-miss, reaction to redirect on creature or projectile movement, bonus action to push all creatures 30 feet (Str save). Turbulence: ranged attacks at disadvantage, flyers halved speed, Str save or knocked prone when entering/starting turn while flying. Thermal Column: upward wind, reduces fall damage by 5× spellcasting modifier, triples vertical jump height.

name: Telekinesis
description: Move creatures or objects by thought for 10 minutes. Each turn use an action to target one: Creature (Huge or smaller) — ability check contested by target's Str; win = move up to 30 feet, restrained in grip until end of your next turn. Object (up to 1,000 lbs uncarried) — move 30 feet automatically; if worn or carried, ability check vs. Str to pull free and move it 30 feet. Can exert fine control (tools, containers, vials). Switch targets freely each turn.

name: Telepathic Bond
components: V, S, M (Pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures)
description: Link up to 8 willing creatures within range telepathically for 1 hour. They can communicate mentally regardless of language or distance, as long as they're on the same plane of existence. Creatures with Int 2 or less are unaffected.

name: Teleportation Circle
components: V, M (Rare chalks and inks infused with precious gems with 50 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: Draw a 10-foot circle linked by sigils to a known permanent teleportation circle on the same plane. A portal opens until end of your next turn; any creature entering exits within 5 feet of the destination. You learn 2 sigil sequences at spell acquisition and can memorize more (1 minute study each). Create a permanent circle by casting this spell in the same location every day for one year.

name: Tree Stride
description: Enter a living tree at least your size using 5 feet of movement. You instantly know the location of all trees of the same kind within 500 feet. As part of the same movement, exit into one of them or step out of the entered tree, appearing within 5 feet of it. You can use this teleportation once per round for the duration. You must end each turn outside a tree.

name: Unearth Legend
components: V, S, M (rare gems worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes, and a jeweled notebook worth at least 200 gp)
description: Offer rare gems (250 gp, consumed) to an otherworldly entity along with a jeweled notebook (200 gp). The entity researches a named person, place, or object for up to 7 days, writing its findings in the notebook. It may learn obscure myths, forgotten legends, or lost secrets. Results may be incomplete, cryptic, or puzzling. The spell ends when the entity has conveyed everything it can discover.

name: Wall of Force
components: V, S, M (A pinch of powder made by crushing a clear gemstone.)
description: An invisible force wall appears: up to ten contiguous 10-foot panels, or a dome or sphere up to 10 feet in radius; 1/4 inch thick. Creatures in the wall's space when it appears are pushed aside. Nothing passes through (physically or ethereally). Immune to all damage, can't be dispelled by dispel magic. Disintegrate destroys it instantly. Extends into the Ethereal Plane.

name: Wall of Stone
components: V, S, M (A small block of granite.)
description: A nonmagical stone wall springs into existence: ten 10-foot × 10-foot panels, 6 inches thick (or 10-foot × 20-foot panels, 3 inches thick). Must merge with and be supported by existing stone. Creatures in the wall's space are pushed aside; if fully enclosed, they make a Dexterity save to move free. Each panel: AC 15, 30 HP per inch of thickness. Maintain concentration for the full duration to make the wall permanent.

name: Wayfinding
components: V, S, M (two divinatory tools to indicate direction or display an image, such as a pendulum and a mirror, worth 100 gp)
description: Name a specific location on the same plane. For 24 hours, choose one effect (swappable as an action): Dowsing — pendulum indicates direction and distance to destination, pulling with increasing urgency as you approach; Ascertainment — at each path choice, points to the most direct route (not necessarily safest); Forecast — mirror shows images of the next 30 miles on your path, revealing natural hazards and obstacles. Fails if the destination moves planes.

name: Whirlpool
description: A 30-foot-radius circle of churning water (difficult terrain, not deep enough to require swimming) appears at a point within range. Creatures starting in or entering on their turn make a Strength save: 5d8 bludgeoning plus pulled 10 feet toward center on fail. If cast on an existing body of water, damage increases by 1d8.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Alter Weather
components: V, S, M (a silver dish and a glass tube filled with quicksilver)
description: Seize control of local weather in a 1-mile radius for 1 hour (requires clear sky view; ends early if you can't see it). On cast and after each 30-minute change, shift precipitation, temperature, and wind each by one stage. Precipitation (5 stages): clear → light clouds → overcast (no sunlight-dependent effects) → rain/hail/snow (lightly obscured 60+ ft) → torrential (heavily obscured 30+ ft, all terrain difficult). Temperature (7 stages): extreme hot (stages 1-2) or cold (stages 6-7) impose exhaustion or ability check penalties. Wind (5 stages): stage 3 ranged attacks at disadvantage, stage 4 resistance to ranged damage, stage 5 ranged attacks impossible and movement against wind doubled. After the spell ends, weather returns to its original state at the same rate.
higherLevel: 7th level: duration 8 hours, radius 5 miles. 8th level: duration 24 hours, radius 10 miles. 9th level: duration 7 days, radius 25 miles.

name: Blade Barrier
description: A vertical wall of whirling razor blades up to 100 feet long (or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter), 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. Provides three-quarters cover, difficult terrain. Creatures entering on their turn or starting their turn there make a Dexterity save: 6d10 slashing on fail, half on success.

name: Call for Aid
description: Contact a powerful extraplanar being which sends one of its servants to appear within range. The servant is friendly but under no obligation to help; it speaks a language you know and typically demands payment (approximately 50 gp/minute, 500 gp/hour, or 5,000 gp/day, adjusted up to 50% based on task alignment or danger). It won't accept suicidal, impossible, or especially lengthy tasks. When payment is exhausted or the task is complete, it returns home.

name: Chain Lightning
components: V, S, M (A bit of fur; a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod; and three silver pins.)
description: Launch a bolt of lightning at a primary target within 150 feet; three secondary bolts each leap to separate targets within 30 feet of the primary. Each target (creature or object, one bolt each) makes a Dexterity save: 10d8 lightning on fail, half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional bolt leaps from the primary target for each slot level above 6th.

name: Circle of Death
components: V, S, M (The powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp.)
description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Constitution save: 8d6 necrotic on fail, half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Conjure Fey
description: Summon a fey creature or fey beast spirit of CR 6 or lower in an unoccupied space within range. It's friendly, obeys verbal commands (no action required), has its own turns. If concentration breaks, you lose control — it becomes hostile and can't be dismissed, disappearing 1 hour after summoning.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the challenge rating limit increases by 1 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Contingency
components: V, S, M (A statuette of yourself carved from ivory and decorated with gems worth at least 1,500 gp.)
description: Cast a 5th-level or lower spell (cast time 1 action, targeting self) simultaneously with contingency, holding it in reserve. Describe a trigger condition; the held spell fires automatically when that condition is first met, then contingency ends. Only one contingency at a time; a second casting ends the first. Also ends if the material component leaves your person.

name: Create Undead
components: V, S, M (One clay pot filled with grave dirt, one clay pot filled with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone for each corpse.)
description: Cast only at night. Choose up to 3 Medium or Small humanoid corpses within range; each becomes a ghoul under your control. Bonus action: command any within 120 feet. Control lasts 24 hours; recast on a creature before that period ends to extend for another 24 hours (this reasserts control rather than animating new creatures).
higherLevel: 7th level: 4 ghouls. 8th level: 5 ghouls or 2 ghasts/wights. 9th level: 6 ghouls, 3 ghasts/wights, or 2 mummies.

name: Disintegrate
components: V, S, M (A lodestone and a pinch of dust.)
description: A green ray springs from your pointing finger. Dexterity save: 10d6+40 force on fail; if reduced to 0 HP, the creature is disintegrated (it, nonmagical gear, and non-magic items reduced to ash; only true resurrection or wish can restore). Magic items are unaffected. Automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or magical force creation; on a Huge or larger object, destroys a 10-foot cube portion.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Divine Temple
components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
description: Create a holy sanctuary (cube up to 60 feet per side) with walls, floor, and roof at a point within range, lasting 24 hours. Divination spells of 6th level and below can't see into it. Choose creature types to oppose (aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead). Opposing creatures make a Charisma save to enter (fail = barred 24 hours; success = -1d4 to all d20 rolls inside). You can block or allow teleportation, interplanar travel, and summoning inside. Cast daily in the same spot for one year to make permanent.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, casting time increases by 1 hour per slot above 6th, size increases by 60 feet per side per slot, and divination blocking extends to match the slot level.

name: Elemental Shield
description: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You gain immunity to that damage type, and chosen creatures within 5 feet gain resistance to it. As a bonus action, change the shield's damage type.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes become inky voids. Each turn, target one creature within 60 feet; it makes a Wisdom save or is affected for the duration by your chosen effect: Asleep — falls unconscious (wakes on damage or if shaken); Panicked — frightened, must Dash away each turn, ends when 60+ feet away with no line of sight to you; Sickened — disadvantage on attacks and ability checks, Wisdom save at end of each turn to end. Can't retarget a creature that succeeded its save against this casting.

name: Find the Path
components: V, S, M (A set of divinatory tools-such as bones, ivory sticks, cards, teeth, or carved runes-worth 100gp and an object from the location you wish to find.)
description: Name a specific fixed location on the same plane. Know its distance and direction for 24 hours. When presented with a choice of paths, you automatically determine which is the most direct route (not necessarily safest). Fails for destinations on another plane, mobile destinations, or non-specific destinations.

name: Fleeting Portals
description: Create two linked 10-foot-diameter gates at points on the ground within 500 feet. Choose one-way or two-way passage. Anything entering one exits the other as if adjacent. As a bonus action, close, open, or move one or both gates up to 60 feet. Ends if a gate moves more than 500 feet from your original location.

name: Flesh to Stone
components: V, S, M (A pinch of lime, water, and earth.)
description: Target a creature within range. Constitution save: fail = restrained as flesh hardens; success = unaffected. A restrained creature makes Con saves at the end of each turn. Three successes: spell ends. Three failures: petrified for the duration. If concentration is maintained for the full duration, the petrification is permanent until dispelled. Physical damage while petrified causes lasting deformities if reverted.

name: Forbiddance
components: V, S, M (A sprinkling of holy water, rare incense, and powdered ruby worth at least 1,000 gp.)
description: Protect up to 40,000 square feet of floor space (up to 30 feet high) for 24 hours. Creatures can't teleport in or use portals to enter; planar travel is blocked. Choose creature types to damage (celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead): when they enter or start a turn there, they take 5d10 radiant or necrotic (your choice). Set an optional password to grant immunity to the damage. Cast daily in the same spot for 30 days to make permanent.

name: Form of Fire
description: Become elemental fire (bright light 30 ft, dim 30 ft) for 10 minutes. Benefits: immune to fire; move through creatures and ignore difficult terrain (1st time per turn entering a creature's space: 2d6 fire); melee attackers within 5 feet take 2d6 fire; action — 30-foot line, Dex save: 6d6 fire on fail, half on success; once per turn, maximize one fire damage die.

name: Form of Ice
description: Become elemental ice for 10 minutes. Benefits: immune to cold; ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow; ground in a 15-foot radius around you is icy difficult terrain for others (moves with you); action — 30-foot cone, Con save: 4d8 cold plus speed halved until your next turn on fail, half damage on success; once per turn when rolling cold damage, gain temporary HP equal to one cold die rolled.

name: Form of Stone
description: Until the spell ends, you gain: resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; you can move across earthen or stone difficult terrain freely and pass through solid earth or stone (ending movement inside ejects you to the nearest unoccupied space, stuns you until end of your next turn, and ends the spell); and you can use your action to raise stone spikes in a 15-foot radius around you (Dexterity saving throw, 4d8 piercing on failure, half on success; the area becomes difficult terrain).

name: Form of Water
description: Until the spell ends, you gain: resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; you can move through other creatures' spaces and ignore difficult terrain (the first time you pass through a Large or smaller creature, it makes a Strength saving throw or falls prone); and you can use your action to unleash a 15-foot-long, 5-foot-wide water blast (Strength saving throw: 5d6 bludgeoning and knocked prone on failure, half and not prone on success).

name: Form of Wind
description: Until the spell ends, you gain: a flying speed of 60 feet; the ability to move through and occupy other creatures' spaces while ignoring difficult terrain; invisibility; and you can use your action to unleash a 30-foot cone wind blast (Strength saving throw: 4d8 bludgeoning and knocked 15 feet away on failure, half damage and not knocked back on success).

name: Freezing Sphere
components: V, S, M (A small crystal sphere.)
description: A frigid globe explodes at a point within range in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 cold damage on failure or half on success. If it strikes water, it freezes the liquid 6 inches deep over a 30-foot square for 1 minute; creatures swimming there become trapped (Strength check vs. DC to break free). Instead of firing immediately, you can hold the globe as a sling stone—it explodes on impact or after 1 minute.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6th.

name: Glacial Orbs
components: V, S, M (a pinch of blue sand)
description: You create three balls of ice that you or another creature can hold, hand off, throw up to 60 feet, or use as sling ammunition. A ball shatters on impact, exploding in a 15-foot radius (Dexterity saving throw: 3d8 cold damage and speed halved until end of next turn on failure, half and no other effects on success). Remaining orbs evaporate when the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, you create one additional ball per slot level above 6th.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (A glass or crystal bead that shatters when the spell ends.)
description: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier forms in a 10-foot radius around you for the duration. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier cannot affect creatures or objects within it, even if cast using a higher-level slot.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, the barrier blocks spells of one additional level per slot level above 6th.

name: Guards and Wards
components: V, S, M (Burning incense, a small measure of brimstone and oil, a knotted string, a small amount of umber hulk blood, and a small silver rod worth at least 10 gp.)
description: You ward up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (up to 20 feet tall). You can exempt specific creatures or set a password. The ward creates these effects: corridors fill with heavy fog; all doors are magically locked (as arcane lock), with up to 10 doors illusioned as walls; stairs fill with webs (as the spell). Additionally, choose one of: dancing lights in four corridors; magic mouth in two locations; stinking cloud in two locations; a constant gust of wind in one corridor; or a suggestion in a 5-foot square (affecting all who pass through). The whole area radiates magic. Dispel magic removes individual effects. Casting this spell daily for one year makes it permanent.

name: Harm
description: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 14d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. The damage cannot reduce the target below 1 hit point. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. Any effect that removes a disease restores the hit point maximum early.

name: Heal
description: A surge of positive energy washes through a creature within range. It regains 70 hit points, and blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting it are ended. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, the healing increases by 10 per slot level above 6th.

name: Heroes' Feast
components: V, S, M (A gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: You conjure a feast that takes 1 hour to consume, with benefits setting in at the end of that time. Up to twelve other creatures can partake. Each partaker is cured of all diseases and poison, becomes immune to poison and the frightened condition, makes all Wisdom saving throws with advantage, and has their hit point maximum increased by 2d10 (gaining those hit points as well). These benefits last 24 hours.

name: Impaling Spires
description: You cause up to ten stone spikes (5-foot space each, up to 30 feet tall, AC 11, 30 HP) to erupt from the ground. Any creature above a spike makes a Dexterity saving throw: 5d10 piercing damage and impaled (restrained at spike's top) on failure, half and no other effects on success. Large or smaller creatures can be impaled; Huge need 2+ spikes, Gargantuan need 6+. An impaled creature can use its action to make Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) vs. your spell save DC to free itself. Spikes crumble after 1 hour.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, you create two additional spikes per slot level above 6th.

name: Instant Summons
components: V, S, M (A sapphire worth 1,000 gp.)
description: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less (longest dimension 6 feet or less), leaving an invisible mark on it and inscribing its name on the sapphire component. At any time thereafter, you can speak the item's name and crush the sapphire to instantly summon it to your hand, ending the spell. If another creature holds it, you instead learn who has it and their approximate location. Dispel magic on the sapphire ends the spell.

name: Irresistible Dance
description: One creature within range that can be charmed must make a Wisdom saving throw or begin dancing in place for the duration. While dancing, the creature uses all its movement staying in its space, has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, the dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to regain control, ending the spell on a success.

name: Magic Jar
components: V, S, M (A gem, crystal, reliquary, or some other ornamental container worth at least 500 gp.)
description: Your soul enters a specially prepared container within range, leaving your body in suspended animation. From the container, you can project your soul up to 100 feet to return to your body (ending the spell) or attempt to possess a humanoid (Charisma saving throw). On failure, you control the target's body using its physical stats but keeping your mental ability scores, alignment, and class features (not the target's). The target's soul is trapped in the container and can perceive through its senses but cannot act. You can return to the container as an action if within 100 feet. If the host body or your original body dies, you must make a Charisma saving throw or die. If the container is destroyed, all souls return to their bodies or die.

name: Martial Transformation
components: V, S, M (a small statuette of a warrior)
description: Until the spell ends, you cannot cast spells or concentrate, but gain: 50 temporary hit points; advantage on weapon attacks and an extra 2d12 force damage on hits; proficiency in all armor, shields, weapons, and Strength and Constitution saving throws; two attacks per Attack action (if you don't already have extra attacks); and conjured magical armor and a weapon of your choice (vanish when the spell ends). When the spell ends, make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. You can end the spell early as a bonus action.

name: Mass Suggestion
components: V, M (A snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil.)
description: You magically suggest a course of action (one or two sentences) to up to twelve creatures within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune. The suggestion must sound reasonable and can't be obviously self-harmful. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw or pursues the action for the duration. If you or your companions harm a target, the effect ends for it.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot, the duration is 10 days. Using an 8th-level slot, 30 days.

name: Move Earth
components: V, S, M (An iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils-clay, loam, and sand.)
description: Choose an area of terrain up to 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower elevation, create or fill trenches, or erect or flatten walls, with changes up to half the area's largest dimension. Each change takes 10 minutes. At the end of every 10 minutes, you can choose a new area. This spell cannot manipulate natural stone. Creatures in the area can't be trapped by the slow movement.

name: Necrotic Sphere
description: You send a pulse of necromantic energy outward in a 60-foot radius from a point you can see, targeting up to eight creatures (starting from the center, prioritizing lower hit points). Each affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on failure or half on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, the number of creatures affected increases by four per slot level above 6th.

name: Petrify
components: V, S, M (a pinch of chalk, water, and dirt)
description: You attempt to petrify a creature within range with a body made of flesh. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. If it fails by 5 or more, it is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a failed save leaves it restrained as it begins to turn to stone. A restrained target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell, three failures petrify it. The petrification lasts until removed by greater restoration or similar magic.

name: Planar Ally
description: You call upon a deity, primordial, or other cosmic power known to you. That entity sends a celestial, elemental, or fiend loyal to it to appear in an unoccupied space within range. The creature is under no compulsion. You can negotiate a service in exchange for payment—simple tasks cost roughly 100 gp per minute, tasks measured in hours cost 1,000 gp per hour, and tasks up to 10 days cost 10,000 gp per day. Hazardous tasks or those against the creature's ethos may cost more or less. If no price is agreed, the creature returns to its home plane immediately.

name: Programmed Illusion
components: V, S, M (A bit of fleece and jade dust worth at least 25 gp.)
description: You create an illusion up to 30 feet in any dimension at a location within range, invisible until triggered. You set the trigger (based on visual or audible conditions within 30 feet) when casting, and define a performance lasting up to 5 minutes. When triggered, the illusion performs its script, then disappears and remains dormant for 10 minutes before it can trigger again. Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion. A creature can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it.

name: Sky Omen
description: You control a magical visual display visible for 1 mile, up to 10 minutes long. It is obviously unnatural. The first time a creature sees the omen, it makes a Wisdom saving throw (a creature can choose to fail if the omen seems positive). On failure, it suffers one effect of your choice: Terror (frightened of the omen), Awe (charmed, won't willingly move where it can't see the omen), or Courage (advantage on saves vs. fear and charm while the omen is visible). At the end of each day, an affected creature can repeat the saving throw.
higherLevel: Using a 7th-level slot: radius becomes 6 miles, duration becomes concentration up to 8 hours. Using an 8th-level slot: 12 miles, up to 24 hours.

name: Sunbeam
description: A beam of brilliant light flashes from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d8 radiant damage and becoming blinded until your next turn on failure, or half damage and not blinded on success. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this save. You can create a new line as your action on each subsequent turn. For the duration, a mote of sunlight in your hand sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for 30 more feet.

name: Transport via Plants
description: You create a magical link between a large plant within range and another plant of the same kind at a known destination you have seen or touched before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant using 5 feet of movement.

name: True Seeing
components: V, S, M (An ointment for the eyes that costs 25gp; is made from mushroom powder, saffron, and fat; and is consumed by the spell.)
description: You touch a creature and grant it truesight, the ability to notice secret doors hidden by magic, and the ability to see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet for the duration.

name: Wall of Ice
components: V, S, M (A small piece of quartz.)
description: You create a wall of ice as a hemispherical dome or sphere (up to 10-foot radius) or up to ten contiguous 10-foot-square panels, 1 foot thick. Any creature in its space when it appears makes a Dexterity saving throw: 10d6 cold damage on failure or half on success. The wall has AC 12 and 30 HP per 10-foot section and is vulnerable to fire. When a section is destroyed, it leaves a frigid air sheet (Constitution saving throw, 5d6 cold damage to pass through).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, wall appearance damage increases by 2d6 and frigid air damage by 1d6 per slot level above 6th.

name: Wall of Thorns
components: V, S, M (A handful of thorns.)
description: A wall of tough thorny brush springs up at a solid surface within range: up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a 20-foot-diameter circle up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight. Each creature in its area when it appears makes a Dexterity saving throw: 7d8 piercing on failure, half on success. Moving through the wall costs 4 feet of movement per foot, and entering or ending a turn there deals 7d8 slashing (Dexterity saving throw).
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level slot or higher, both damage types increase by 1d8 per slot level above 6th.

name: Wind Walk
components: V, S, M (Fire and holy water.)
description: You and up to ten willing creatures within range assume a gaseous cloud form for the duration, gaining a flying speed of 300 feet and resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons. The only actions available in cloud form are Dash or reverting to normal form (reverting takes 1 minute, during which the creature is incapacitated). You can revert back to cloud form later. When the spell ends while flying in cloud form, the creature descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute before landing safely.

name: Word of Recall
description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to your previously designated sanctuary. You appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated. To designate a sanctuary, you must cast this spell within a location dedicated to or strongly linked to your deity. Casting without a designated sanctuary has no effect.

name: Wound
description: You send a surge of negative energy into a creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 14d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. The target's hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the necrotic damage it took.

name: Arcane Sword
components: V, S, M (A miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp.)
description: You evoke a sword-shaped plane of force that appears and lasts for the duration. When it appears, make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword; on a hit, it takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action each turn to move the sword up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against the same or a different target.

name: Arcanist's Sword
components: V, S, M (a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp)
description:
You create a glowing sword of force that hovers within range for the duration. When it appears and as a bonus action on later turns, give it one command:
- Attack: Move up to 20 feet and make a melee spell attack (3d10 + spellcasting modifier force damage on hit).
- Guard: Move into a creature's space, granting it half cover; makes a melee spell attack against the first hostile creature that comes within 5 feet (3d10 + modifier force, then can't attack again until commanded).
- Whirl: Move up to 20 feet, then spin—creatures starting in or passing within 5 feet make a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d10 force damage.

name: Confinement
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500 gp)
description: An invisible, immobile force prison springs into existence within range. Choose a cage (up to 20 feet on a side, 1/2-inch bars with half cover) or solid box (up to 10 feet on a side, blocking matter and spells through its walls). Any creature fully inside when cast is trapped; partial or oversized creatures are pushed out. Trapped creatures cannot leave by nonmagical means. To teleport or use planar travel to escape, they must succeed on a Charisma saving throw. The cage extends into the Ethereal Plane and cannot be dispelled by dispel magic. AC 17, 140 HP.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using an 8th-level slot or higher, the cage's AC increases by 1 and its hit points increase by 20 per slot level above 7th.

name: Conjure Celestial
description: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space within range. It is friendly to you and your companions, rolls its own initiative, and obeys your verbal commands. The celestial disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level slot, you summon a celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower.

name: Death Ray
description: You send a beam of negative energy at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. The creature takes 8d10 + 30 necrotic damage on a hit, or half as much on a miss. If a humanoid dies from this spell or within 1 minute of being hit, it rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and attacks the nearest living creature.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using an 8th-level slot or higher, the damage increases by 2d10 per slot level above 7th.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
components: V, S, M (A tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur.)
description: A glowing bead appears at a point within range and lingers for the duration, accumulating power. When the spell ends (by your choice or broken concentration), the bead explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw: base 12d6 fire damage on failure (or half on success), increasing by 1d6 for each round you held it. If touched, the toucher makes a Dexterity saving throw or triggers it; on success, they can throw it up to 40 feet. The fire damages objects and ignites flammables.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using an 8th-level slot or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7th.

name: Divine Word
description: Choose any number of creatures within range that can hear you. Each makes a Charisma saving throw. On failure, the effect depends on current hit points: 50 HP or fewer—deafened 1 minute; 40 HP or fewer—deafened and blinded 10 minutes; 30 HP or fewer—blinded, deafened, and dazed 1 hour; 20 HP or fewer—killed instantly. Regardless of HP, any celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend that fails is banished to its home plane and cannot return for 24 hours (except via wish).

name: Etherealness
description: You enter the Border Ethereal for the duration. You can move in any direction (vertical movement costs double). You can see and hear your origin plane in grayscale to 60 feet, but can only affect and be affected by other Ethereal creatures. You ignore objects on your origin plane and can move through them. When the spell ends, you return to your origin plane; if the space is occupied, you are shunted to the nearest free space and take force damage equal to twice the distance shunted.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using an 8th-level slot or higher, you can target up to three willing creatures (including you) per slot level above 7th. Targets must be within 10 feet of you.

name: Finger of Death
description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie permanently under your command.

name: Fire Storm
description: You create a firestorm of up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes (each must share a face with another) within range. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 fire damage on failure or half on success. The fire damages objects and ignites flammables. If you choose, plant life in the area is unaffected.

name: Forcecage
components: V, S, M (Ruby dust worth 1,500 gp.)
description: An invisible, immobile force prison springs into existence within range. Choose a cage (up to 20 feet on a side, 1/2-inch bars with half cover) or solid box (up to 10 feet on a side, blocking matter and spells through its walls). Any creature fully inside when cast is trapped; partial or oversized creatures are pushed out. Trapped creatures cannot leave by nonmagical means. To teleport or use planar travel to escape, they must succeed on a Charisma saving throw. The cage extends into the Ethereal Plane and cannot be dispelled by dispel magic.

name: Glyph of Power
components: V, S, M (500 gp worth of gem dust, dependent on effect, which the spell consumes)
description:
You inscribe a 5-foot-diameter arcane glyph on a fixed surface. When a creature enters its space or disturbs it, the glyph triggers. You can refine the trigger to specific creatures or types, or allow a password to suppress it. It requires an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs. your spell save DC to find. When triggered, choose one effect targeting every non-exempt creature within 60 feet:
- Weakness (Amethyst): Strength save or speed 15 ft and minimum weapon damage for 1 hour.
- Binding (Topaz): Dexterity save or restrained by force for 1 hour.
- Death (Black Sapphire): Constitution save or drop to 0 HP; on success, 10d8 necrotic.
- Bafflement (Citrine): Intelligence save or lose ability to cast and have disadvantage on checks/attacks for 1 hour.
- Rage (Garnet): Wisdom save or become hostile and attack nearest creature (save again each turn).
- Stupor (Emerald): Charisma save or enter dazed state (no actions, half speed) for 1 hour or until damaged.

name: Magnificent Mansion
components: V, S, M (A miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each item worth at least 5 gp.)
description: You conjure a portal to an extradimensional dwelling up to 50 10-foot cubes in size. The portal is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You and designated creatures can enter while the portal remains open (you can open/close it within 30 feet). Inside is a fully furnished mansion with fresh air, food for a nine-course banquet for 100 people, and a staff of 100 near-transparent servants who obey your orders but can't attack or harm others. Furnishings dissipate if removed. Creatures inside are expelled when the spell ends.

name: Mirage Arcane
description: Over 10 minutes, you make terrain up to 1 mile square appear different for the duration. The general shape remains, but the appearance can change completely (swamp to meadow, cliff to slope, etc.). You can also alter or add structures. The illusion includes audible, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements, and can create or remove difficult terrain. Truesight sees through the illusion but other elements remain. Illusory terrain pieces removed from the area disappear.

name: Plane Shift
components: V, S, M (A forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence.)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures grasp a forked metal rod attuned to a specific plane and are transported there, appearing near a specified destination at the DM's discretion. If you know a teleportation circle's sigil sequence on another plane, the spell can take you there. Alternatively, you can target an unwilling creature within reach: make a melee spell attack; on a hit, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or is transported to a random location on a plane you specify.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: Each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll d8: 1=10d6 fire; 2=10d6 acid; 3=10d6 lightning; 4=10d6 poison; 5=10d6 cold; 6=restrained (Constitution saves at end of each turn: 3 successes end, 3 failures permanently petrify); 7=blinded (then Wisdom save next turn: success ends blindness, failure plane-shifted); 8=struck by two rays (roll twice more, rerolling 8s). Half damage on save for damage-only rays; no save effect on success.

name: Project Image
components: V, S, M (A small replica of you made from materials worth at least 5 gp.)
description: You create an intangible illusory copy of yourself at any location within range you have seen before. The illusion looks and sounds like you but is physically insubstantial. As an action you can move it up to twice your speed and make it gesture, speak, or behave as you choose. As a bonus action, you can switch between using your own senses or the illusion's (while using its senses you are blinded and deafened). Physical interaction reveals it as an illusion. Intelligence (Investigation) vs. your spell save DC to discern.

name: Rain of Fire
description: A firestorm forms at a height between 20 and 300 feet above you, centered overhead. When cast and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you call down five cylinders of fire (5-foot radius each) at points within 120 feet. Each creature in a cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on failure or half on success. A creature in multiple areas is affected only once. The fire ignites flammable objects not worn or carried.

name: Regenerate
components: V, S, M (A prayer wheel and holy water.)
description: A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 hit points. For the spell's duration, the target also regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points per minute). Any severed body parts—fingers, limbs, tails—are restored after 2 minutes. If you hold a severed part to the stump, it instantly reattaches.

name: Rejuvenation
description: A creature you touch regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns for the duration. When the target reaches its hit point maximum while under this effect, scars are healed, missing limbs and digits regrow, and permanent wounds are fully mended. The spell ends early if the target takes a single instance of fire or acid damage equal to or greater than twice your level.

name: Resurrection
components: V, S, M (A diamond worth at least 1,000gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: You touch a dead creature that has been dead no longer than a century. If its soul is free and willing, it returns to life with all its hit points. This spell neutralizes poisons, cures normal diseases, closes all wounds, and restores missing body parts. Magical diseases and curses are not removed. The target takes a -4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks, reduced by 1 for each long rest. If you cast this spell on a creature dead for more than 1 year, you cannot cast spells again until you finish a long rest.

name: Reverse Gravity
components: V, S, M (A lodestone and iron filings.)
description: Gravity reverses in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects not anchored to the ground fall upward to the top of the area. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab a fixed object it can reach. If a solid ceiling is encountered, falling creatures and objects strike it normally. At the end of the duration, everything falls back down.

name: Safekeeping
components: V, S, M (a thread of flax covered with powder from precious gems worth at least 1000 gp per target, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch up to 8 willing creatures or objects, hiding each for the duration. Each becomes invisible or is transformed to appear as a same-size object (such as a statue). Divination spells cannot locate or perceive them. Affected creatures are incapacitated and do not age or need to breathe, eat, or drink. The spell ends for a target if it takes any damage. You can define a condition for early release (GM must approve).

name: Scintillant Blast
description:
You send a shimmering wave in a 60-foot cone. For each creature in the cone, roll 1d8: it makes a Dexterity saving throw or suffers the rolled effect (on success, half initial damage only).
1=12d4 acid now+12d4 at end of next turn; 2=9d8 cold+restrained; 3=14d6 fire; 4=6d12 lightning+no reactions+disadv on Dex saves; 5=6d12 poison+poisoned; 6=9d8 psychic+stunned; 7=9d8 thunder+knockback 30 ft+prone; 8=struck by two blasts (roll twice more, rerolling 8s).

name: Sequester
components: V, S, M (A powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: A willing creature or object becomes invisible and cannot be targeted by divination spells or detected by scrying sensors for the duration. If the target is a creature, it enters suspended animation (time stops, no aging). You can set a condition for early release (DM must approve; must be possible within 1 mile of the target). The spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

name: Simulacrum
components: V, S, M (Snow or ice in quantities sufficient to made a life-size copy of the duplicated creature; some hair, fingernail clippings, or other piece of that creature's body placed inside the snow or ice; and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp, sprinkled over the duplicate and consumed by the spell.)
description: You shape ice or snow into a duplicate of a beast or humanoid you can see within range, partially real. The simulacrum has half the original's maximum hit points, no equipment, obeys your commands, and acts on your turn. It can't learn, improve, or regain spent spell slots. Damaged simulacra can be repaired in an alchemical lab (100 gp per HP restored). The simulacrum is destroyed if it reaches 0 HP. Casting this spell again instantly destroys any active simulacrum you created.

name: Soul Transfer
components: V, S, M (a tiny ornate container worth at least 500 gp)
description: Your soul enters a specially prepared container within range, leaving your body in suspended animation. You can project your soul up to 100 feet to return to your body (ending the spell) or attempt to possess a humanoid (Charisma saving throw). On failure, you control the target using its physical stats but your mental ability scores and alignment. The possessed creature's soul is trapped in the container and can repeat the saving throw as an action after every hour. If the host dies while possessed, make a Charisma saving throw or die. If the container is destroyed, all souls return to their bodies or die.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using an 8th-level slot, the possessed creature can repeat its saving throw once per day. Using a 9th-level slot, once per year.

name: Symbol
components: V, S, M (Mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.)
description:
You inscribe a harmful glyph on a surface (up to 10 feet in diameter) or inside a closeable object. The glyph is nearly invisible (Intelligence (Investigation) vs. your spell save DC to find). Set a trigger when casting (touch, step on it, approach within a distance, open the object, etc.). You can exempt specific creatures or set a password. When triggered, the glyph glows for 10 minutes in a 60-foot sphere. Each creature in the sphere is affected by the chosen effect:
- Death: Constitution save or 10d10 necrotic (half on success).
- Discord: Constitution save or argue uncontrollably 1 min (disadvantage on attacks/checks, can't communicate).
- Fear: Wisdom save or frightened 1 min (drop items, move 30+ ft from glyph each turn).
- Hopelessness: Charisma save or unable to attack or target creatures 1 min.
- Insanity: Intelligence save or driven insane 1 min (DM controls erratic movement).
- Pain: Constitution save or incapacitated 1 min.
- Sleep: Wisdom save or unconscious 10 min (wakes on damage or being shaken).
- Stunned: Wisdom save or stunned 1 min.

name: Teleport
description:
You teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures within range, or one object fitting in a 10-foot cube (not held by an unwilling creature), to a known destination on the same plane. The DM rolls d100: the result depends on your familiarity.
- Permanent circle (known sigil): on target.
- Associated object (from destination within 6 months): 1–5 on target, 6–13 off target, 14–24 similar area, 25–100 mishap.
- Very familiar: 01–05 mishap, 06–13 similar area, 14–24 off target, 25–100 on target.
- Seen casually: 01–33 mishap, 34–43 similar area, 44–66 off target, 67–100 on target.
- Viewed once: 01–43 mishap, 44–66 similar area, 67–100 off target.
- Description: 01–43 mishap, 44–100 similar area.
- False destination: 01–50 mishap, 51–100 similar area.
Mishap: 3d10 force damage to each teleporting creature, then reroll.

name: Twister
description: A twister appears at a point within range, occupying a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder. As an action, you can move it up to 30 feet along the ground. When a creature enters the twister or starts its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw: 10d6 bludgeoning damage and (if Large or smaller) sucked up and restrained on failure. Restrained creatures are carried 25 feet upward each round. At the end of each of its turns, a restrained creature repeats the save: on success, it is hurled 60 feet horizontally in a random direction. The area is lightly obscured and ranged attacks through it automatically miss.

name: Animal Shapes
description: Choose any number of willing creatures within range. You transform each into a Large or smaller beast with challenge rating 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new (different) forms. Each transformation lasts until the target drops to 0 hit points, dies, or the spell ends. The target assumes the beast's statistics and hit points but retains its alignment and mental ability scores. Its gear melds into the form; it can't cast spells or speak.

name: Antimagic Field
components: V, S, M (A pinch of powdered iron or iron filings.)
description: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic moves with you, centered on you. Within it: spells can't be cast; summoned creatures disappear; magic items become mundane; spells and effects are suppressed (time still counts toward duration); teleportation and planar travel fail; extradimensional spaces close; and magical creatures temporarily wink out. Dispel magic has no effect on the sphere. Spells created by artifacts or deities are unaffected.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
components: V, S, M (Either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect.)
description:
You target a Huge or smaller object, creature, or area up to a 200-foot cube within range, and choose a kind of intelligent creature. Choose one effect:
- Antipathy: The chosen creatures feel an intense urge to leave. When within 60 feet of or seeing the target, they make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened and move away. If more than 60 feet away and unable to see it, the fear ends but resumes on reapproach.
- Sympathy: The chosen creatures feel compelled to approach. When within 60 feet or seeing the target, they make a Wisdom saving throw or use their movement toward it and can't willingly leave. Affected creatures repeat the save every 24 hours.

name: Clone
components: V, S, M (A diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud-filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water.)
description: You create a duplicate of a living creature from a small piece of flesh in a sealed vessel. The clone grows to full size in 120 days (or as a younger version if you choose) and remains inert indefinitely until the original creature dies. If the soul is free and willing, it transfers to the clone, which is physically identical with the same personality, memories, and abilities but none of the original's equipment. The original's remains become inert and cannot be restored to life thereafter.

name: Control Weather
components: V, S, M (Burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water.)
description: While outdoors and maintaining a clear path to the sky, you control the weather within 5 miles for the duration. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. Changes take 1d4 × 10 minutes to take effect. You can change conditions again after each 10-minute interval. Find the current condition on the DM's weather tables and change its stage by one, up or down (wind direction can be changed freely). Weather gradually returns to normal when the spell ends.

name: Demiplane
description: A shadowy door appears on a flat surface within range. It leads to a demiplane—an empty room 30 feet in each dimension made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears; any creatures or objects inside are trapped there. Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect to one created by a previous casting. If you know the nature of another caster's demiplane, you can connect to theirs instead.

name: Dominate Monster
description: You attempt to beguile any creature within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it). On failure, it is charmed by you for the duration. While charmed, you have a telepathic link with it and can issue commands (no action required) for it to obey. As an action, you can take total control, dictating all its actions until the end of your next turn. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the saving throw, ending the spell on success.
higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

name: Earthquake
components: V, S, M (A pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay.)
description: An intense tremor shakes a 100-foot-radius circle centered on a point within range. The ground becomes difficult terrain. Each concentrating creature on the ground makes a Constitution saving throw or loses concentration. Each creature on the ground makes a Dexterity saving throw each turn or falls prone. Additional effects: 1d6 fissures (1d10 × 10 ft deep, 10 ft wide) open at the start of your next turn (Dexterity save to avoid falling in). Structures in the area take 50 bludgeoning damage per turn; collapsed structures deal 5d6 bludgeoning to nearby creatures (Dexterity save).

name: Feeblemind
components: V, S, M (A handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres.)
description: You blast the mind of a creature within range, dealing 4d6 psychic damage (Intelligence saving throw). On failure, the target's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. It can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate. It can still recognize and follow friends. Every 30 days, it can repeat the saving throw. The spell also ends with greater restoration, heal, or wish.

name: Glibness
description: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number rolled with 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would detect whether you are telling the truth always indicates you are being truthful.

name: Great Wave
description: You create a 50-foot-long, 50-foot-high, 10-foot-thick wall of water at a point you can see. You can extend the casting time (up to 6 rounds), adding 50 feet in length and height and 10 feet in thickness per round (maximum 300 × 300 × 60 ft). When the wall appears, each creature within it makes a Strength saving throw: 6d10 bludgeoning on failure, half on success. At the start of each of your turns, the wall moves 50 feet along the ground (Huge or smaller creatures inside make a Strength save or take 5d10 bludgeoning). The wall shrinks by 50 feet in height each turn, reducing damage by 1d10, until it reaches 0 and ends.

name: Holy Aura
components: V, S, M (A tiny reliquary worth at least 1,000gp containing a sacred relic, such as a scrap of cloth from a saint's robe or a piece of parchment from a religious text.)
description: Divine light washes out from you in a 30-foot radius. Creatures you choose in that radius shed dim light in a 5-foot radius, have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. When a fiend or undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the aura flashes; the attacker makes a Constitution saving throw or is blinded until the spell ends.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: A swirling cloud of smoke and white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is heavily obscured. Each creature in it when it appears makes a Dexterity saving throw: 10d8 fire on failure, half on success. A creature moving into the cloud or ending its turn there repeats the save. The cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you at the start of each of your turns. A moderate or stronger wind disperses it early.

name: Maze
description: You banish a creature within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes. As an action, the target can attempt a DC 20 Intelligence check to find the exit (a minotaur or goristro demon automatically succeeds). When the spell ends, the target reappears in its original space or the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Mind Blank
description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition. The spell foils even wish spells and effects of similar power used to affect or observe the target's mind.

name: Mind Link
components: V, S, M (a piece of sea coral and a spiderweb)
description: You attempt to form a telepathic link with a creature you can perceive or know of. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw modified by familiarity (+10 on a different plane, +5 secondhand, 0 firsthand, -5 familiar or in sight/hearing). The target can choose to fail. On failure, you and the target can communicate telepathically. Additionally, you can cast any divination or illusion spell of 4th level or lower on the linked target regardless of range, and can use your action to use its senses until your next turn. If you cast a spell this way, the target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

name: Power Word Stun
description: You speak a word of power that overwhelms the mind of one creature you can see within range. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. The stunned target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

name: Seal Away
components: V, S, M (a sculpted or painted likeness of the target, and black emeralds worth at least 200gp per Hit Die of the target, which are consumed)
description: You prepare a magical prison for a creature within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or is imprisoned eternally (immune to this spell for 1 year on success). While imprisoned, the target doesn't age, need food, water, or air, and can't be found by divination magic. You choose the form of the prison (sealed demiplane, miniaturized in a gemstone, buried underground, etc.) and must specify a release condition (possible and reasonable, DM must approve). Dispel magic cannot free the target.

name: Shatter Mind
description: You blast the mind of a creature within range, dealing 4d6 psychic damage (Intelligence saving throw). On failure, the target's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. It cannot cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, use weapons or tools, or communicate, though it can still recognize threats. After 1 day it can repeat the saving throw; each failure adds another day before the next attempt. The spell also ends with greater restoration, heal, or wish.

name: Sunburst
components: V, S, M (Fire and a piece of sunstone.)
description: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point within range. Each creature in the light makes a Constitution saving throw: 12d6 radiant damage and blinded for 1 minute on failure, half damage and not blinded on success. Undead and oozes have disadvantage. A blinded creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success. This spell dispels any magical darkness in its area.

name: Withering Field
components: V, S, M (a fistful of fine sand and a drop of blood)
description: You shrivel every living thing in a 30-foot cube within range. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw: 12d8 necrotic damage, halved speed, and disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until end of its next turn on failure; half damage and no other effects on success. Constructs and undead automatically succeed; plants have disadvantage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this spell crumbles to dust.

name: Astral Projection
components: V, S, M (For each creature you affect with this spell, you must provide one jacinth worth at least 1,000gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100gp, all of which the spell consumes.)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your souls onto the Astral Plane, leaving your bodies behind in suspended animation. Your astral form replicates your statistics and possessions and is tethered to your body by a silver cord; cutting the cord kills you instantly. Your astral form can travel freely through the Astral Plane and pass into other planes. Damage to your astral form doesn't affect your physical body. The spell ends if you dismiss it, if dispel magic targets your astral or physical form, or if either form drops to 0 HP. When it ends, your soul returns to your body. If a companion's spell ends early, they must find their own way back.

name: Foresight
description: You touch a willing creature and bestow limited prescience. For the duration, the target can't be surprised, has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against it. The spell ends immediately if you cast it again before the duration expires.

name: Gate
components: V, S, M (A diamond worth at least 5,000gp.)
description: You conjure a circular portal (5–20 feet in diameter) at a point within range, connecting to a location on another plane. The portal has a front and back; travel is only possible through its front. Anything passing through is instantly transported to the other plane in the nearest unoccupied space. Deities and planar rulers can prevent portals from opening in their domain. When casting, you can speak the name of a specific creature on another plane; the portal opens near that creature and draws it through to your side, though it is free to act as the DM decides.

name: Imprisonment
components: V, S, M (A vellum depiction or a carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500gp per Hit Die of the target.)
description:
You magically restrain a creature within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw or is bound. While bound, it doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, doesn't age, and can't be detected by divination. Choose the form of imprisonment:
- Burial: Entombed in a force sphere far underground; nothing passes through.
- Chaining: Restrained by magical chains; can't move.
- Hedged Prison: Transported to a tiny warded demiplane (labyrinth, cage, or tower).
- Minimus Containment: Shrunk to 1 inch and sealed inside a gemstone.
- Slumber: Magical sleep; can't be woken.
You can specify a release condition (DM must approve). Dispel magic ends the spell only if cast as a 9th-level spell targeting the prison or its component.

name: Mass Heal
description: You restore up to 700 hit points divided as you choose among any number of creatures within range. Creatures healed are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to four points you can see within range. Each point is the center of a 40-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw: 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on failure, half on success. A creature in multiple areas is affected only once. The spell damages objects and ignites flammables.

name: Phantasmal Nightmares
description: You create horrifying illusions in the minds of creatures you can see within 30 feet of a point within range. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw or becomes frightened for the duration. While frightened, at the start of each of its turns, a target takes 6d10 psychic damage and rolls 1d10: 1=unconscious until it takes damage or is woken; 2–3=paralyzed; 4–5=stunned; 6–7=speed reduced to 0; 8–10=mute. Effects last until the start of its next turn. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell for itself on a success.

name: Power Word Kill
description: You utter a word of power that compels one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

name: Prismatic Wall
description:
A shimmering multicolored opaque wall (up to 90 ft × 30 ft, 1 inch thick) or a 30-foot-diameter sphere forms within range. Any creature within 20 feet that can see it must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The wall has seven layers, each passed one at a time (Dexterity save):
1 Red: 10d6 fire (destroyed by 25 cold damage)
2 Orange: 10d6 acid; blocks magical ranged attacks (destroyed by strong wind)
3 Yellow: 10d6 lightning (destroyed by 60 force damage)
4 Green: 10d6 poison (destroyed by passwall or similar)
5 Blue: 10d6 cold (destroyed by 25 fire damage)
6 Indigo: restrained; 3 Constitution save failures=permanently petrified; blocks spells (destroyed by daylight)
7 Violet: blinded; Wisdom save failure=plane-shifted (destroyed by dispel magic)

name: Shapechange
components: V, S, M (A jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell.)
description: You assume the form of any non-construct, non-undead creature with a challenge rating equal to or less than your level (you must have seen it once). You take its physical statistics and hit points, retaining your alignment and mental ability scores, plus your skill and saving throw proficiencies. You keep your class features if physically possible. You can't use legendary or lair actions. When you drop to 0 HP, excess carries to your original form. As an action, you can change to a different qualifying form, keeping your current hit points unless the new form has fewer.

name: Storm of Vengeance
description:
A storm cloud spreads to a 360-foot radius above you. Lightning flashes, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature beneath the cloud makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 2d6 thunder and becomes deafened for 5 minutes. While you concentrate, additional effects occur each round:
Round 2: 1d6 acid damage to all below.
Round 3: Six lightning bolts strike six targets (Dexterity save: 10d6 lightning on failure, half on success).
Round 4: Hailstones deal 2d6 bludgeoning to all below.
Rounds 5–10: Difficult terrain, heavily obscured, 1d6 cold damage; ranged weapon attacks impossible; gusts disperse fog and mists.

name: Synaptic Shockwave
description: A wave of psionic energy bursts outward in a 60-foot cone. Each creature makes an Intelligence saving throw: 10d8 psychic damage and stunned on failure, half and not stunned on success. At the end of each of a stunned creature's turns, it rolls 1d6 and reduces its Intelligence score by that amount, then repeats the saving throw with a bonus equal to the total Int lost. On success, it's no longer stunned. A creature's Intelligence reduced to 0 kills it. Each long rest restores 1 lost Intelligence point (heal, mass heal, regenerate, and wish restore all; greater restoration restores 1d6).

name: Tempest
description:
A storm cloud forms in a 60-foot-radius cylinder up to 2,000 feet high. Each creature starting its turn below the cloud makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 4d8 thunder and is deafened until its next turn. As an action, you can add one of the following cumulative effects:
- Lightning: Bonus action to strike two points (4d12 lightning, Dexterity save, 10-foot radius).
- Downpour: Area becomes difficult terrain and heavily obscured to all but you.
- Hurricane: Ranged weapon attacks miss; Large and smaller creatures make Strength saves or are thrown 30 ft and knocked prone.
- Hailstorm: 2d10 bludgeoning each turn; disadvantage on concentration saves.
- Expansion: Move the storm 120 feet or increase radius by 60 feet (can be added multiple times).

name: Time Stop
description: You briefly stop time for everyone but yourself. You take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row during which you can act and move normally. The spell ends if any of your actions or effects affect another creature or object carried by someone else, or if you move more than 1,000 feet from where you cast it.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (A drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke.)
description:
You transform a creature or nonmagical, unworn/uncarried object within range into a different form for the duration. If you concentrate for the full duration, the transformation becomes permanent.
- Creature into creature: New form must be CR equal to or less than target's CR/level. Target assumes the new form's statistics (keeping mental ability scores, alignment, and personality).
- Creature into object: Target transforms along with its equipment; it has no memory of this form.
- Object into creature: Creature must be no larger than the object and CR 9 or lower; it is friendly to you and acts on your turns.
An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to resist.

name: True Resurrection
components: V, S, M (A sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000gp, which the spell consumes.)
description: You return a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years to life (provided its soul is free and willing). It returns with all its hit points. The spell closes all wounds, neutralizes poison, cures all diseases, lifts all curses, and replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs. If the original body no longer exists, you must speak the creature's name; it appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you.

name: Weird
description: Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration. At the start of each frightened creature's turns, it makes another Wisdom saving throw or takes 4d10 psychic damage from illusions of its worst fears. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

name: Wish
description:
Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. The basic use is to duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower without meeting its requirements. Alternatively, choose one effect: create an object worth up to 25,000 gp (not a magic item, no larger than 300 feet in any dimension); restore all hit points to up to 20 creatures and end greater restoration effects on them; grant up to 10 creatures resistance to a damage type; grant up to 10 creatures immunity to a spell or magical effect for 8 hours; or force a reroll of any roll made within the last round (advantage or disadvantage, your choice). Effects beyond these examples are subject to DM interpretation and risk.

Stress of using wish for anything other than duplicating a spell: you take 1d10 necrotic damage per spell level cast until your next long rest, your Strength drops to 3 for 2d4 days (resting reduces recovery by 2 days per day), and there is a 33% chance you can never cast wish again.
